CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS thcdnaproddata.aci.t_ade_report_stging_lab1
CLUSTER BY hss_id, ENCNTR_ID AS
WITH
  clinical_events AS (
    SELECT
      HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
      event_id,
      ORDER_ID,
      ENCNTR_ID,
      EVENT_CD,
      EVENT_TAG,
      CLINSIG_UPDT_DT_TM,
      EVENT_RELTN_CD,
      EVENT_START_DT_TM,
      PERFORMED_PRSNL_ID,
      catalog_cd,
      NORMALCY_CD,
      RESULT_VAL,
      updt_dt_tm
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_clinical_event_hist
    WHERE VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM > CURRENT_DATETIME('America/Chicago')
      AND EVENT_RELTN_CD IN (132, 135)
      AND RESULT_STATUS_CD IN (23, 25)
      AND EVENT_CLASS_CD NOT IN (654645)
      AND view_level = 1
      AND AUTHENTIC_FLAG = 1
      AND event_end_dt_tm >= DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR), YEAR)
  ),
  orders AS (
    SELECT
      HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
      ORDER_ID
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_orders_hist
    WHERE CATALOG_TYPE_CD = 2513
  ),
  ade_ref AS (
    SELECT
      ade_hss_id,
      ADE_NAME,
      LAB_PRIMARY_ORDERABLE,
      LAB_EVENT_DISPLAY
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.dw_ade_ref
    WHERE ADE_TYPE = 'Laboratory'
      AND ACTIVE_IND = 1
  )
SELECT
  s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AS hss_id,
  s_ce.event_id,
  s_ce.ORDER_ID,
  s_ce.ENCNTR_ID,
  s_ce.EVENT_CD,
  cv.DISPLAY AS catalog_disp,
  cv.DESCRIPTION AS catalog_description,
  cv1.code_value_pk AS event_pk,
  cv1.code_value_ak AS event_ak,
  cv1.description AS event_desc,
  cv1.display AS event_disp,
  REPLACE(s_ce.EVENT_TAG, '\\\\', '\\') AS event_tag,
  s_ce.CLINSIG_UPDT_DT_TM,
  s_ce.EVENT_RELTN_CD,
  IFNULL(s_ce.EVENT_START_DT_TM, s_ce.CLINSIG_UPDT_DT_TM) AS PERFORMED_DT_TM_UTC,
  s_ce.PERFORMED_PRSNL_ID AS PERFORMED_PERSONNEL_sK,
  s_ce.catalog_cd AS event_catalog_sk,
  CASE WHEN s_ce.NORMALCY_CD IN (201, 203, 215) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RESULT_VALUE_IND,
  REPLACE(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(s_ce.RESULT_VAL, '>', '+'), '<', '-')), '\\\\', '\\') AS RESULT_VALUE,
  ar.ADE_NAME,
  s_ce.updt_dt_tm AS ods_process_dt_tm
FROM clinical_events AS s_ce
INNER JOIN orders AS s_o
  ON s_o.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
  AND s_o.ORDER_ID = s_ce.ORDER_ID
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.aci.dw_code_value AS cv
  ON cv.CODE_VALUE_HSS_ID = s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
  AND cv.CODE_VALUE_SK = s_ce.CATALOG_CD
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.aci.dw_code_value AS cv1
  ON cv1.CODE_VALUE_HSS_ID = s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
  AND cv1.CODE_VALUE_SK = s_ce.EVENT_CD
INNER JOIN ade_ref AS ar
  ON cv.DISPLAY = ar.LAB_PRIMARY_ORDERABLE
  AND (
    s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = ar.ade_hss_id
    OR ar.ade_hss_id IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    cv1.DISPLAY LIKE ar.LAB_EVENT_DISPLAY
    OR ar.LAB_EVENT_DISPLAY IS NULL
  );

      fact_order_sk,

      TEMPLATE_ORDER_FLG,

    SELECT
      CAST(hss_id AS STRING) AS hss_id,

      NURSING_UNIT_LOCATION

-- 4. Validation Step: Compare the two tables and check optimized duplicates.
-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View discrepancy rows.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES;

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS thcdnaproddata.aci.t_ade_report_stging_lab1
CLUSTER BY hss_id, ENCNTR_ID AS
WITH
  clinical_events AS (
    SELECT
      HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
      event_id,
      ORDER_ID,
      ENCNTR_ID,
      EVENT_CD,
      EVENT_TAG,
      CLINSIG_UPDT_DT_TM,
      EVENT_RELTN_CD,
      EVENT_START_DT_TM,
      PERFORMED_PRSNL_ID,
      catalog_cd,
      NORMALCY_CD,
      RESULT_VAL,
      updt_dt_tm
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_clinical_event_hist
    WHERE VALID_UNTIL_DT_TM > CURRENT_DATETIME('America/Chicago')
      AND EVENT_RELTN_CD IN (132, 135)
      AND RESULT_STATUS_CD IN (23, 25)
      AND EVENT_CLASS_CD NOT IN (654645)
      AND view_level = 1
      AND AUTHENTIC_FLAG = 1
      AND event_end_dt_tm >= DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR), YEAR)
  ),
  orders AS (
    SELECT
      HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
      ORDER_ID
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_orders_hist
    WHERE CATALOG_TYPE_CD = 2513
  ),
  ade_ref AS (
    SELECT
      ade_hss_id,
      ADE_NAME,
      LAB_PRIMARY_ORDERABLE,
      LAB_EVENT_DISPLAY
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.dw_ade_ref
    WHERE ADE_TYPE = 'Laboratory'
      AND ACTIVE_IND = 1
  )
SELECT
  s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AS hss_id,
  s_ce.event_id,
  s_ce.ORDER_ID,
  s_ce.ENCNTR_ID,
  s_ce.EVENT_CD,
  cv.DISPLAY AS catalog_disp,
  cv.DESCRIPTION AS catalog_description,
  cv1.code_value_pk AS event_pk,
  cv1.code_value_ak AS event_ak,
  cv1.description AS event_desc,
  cv1.display AS event_disp,
  REPLACE(s_ce.EVENT_TAG, '\\\\', '\\') AS event_tag,
  s_ce.CLINSIG_UPDT_DT_TM,
  s_ce.EVENT_RELTN_CD,
  IFNULL(s_ce.EVENT_START_DT_TM, s_ce.CLINSIG_UPDT_DT_TM) AS PERFORMED_DT_TM_UTC,
  s_ce.PERFORMED_PRSNL_ID AS PERFORMED_PERSONNEL_sK,
  s_ce.catalog_cd AS event_catalog_sk,
  CASE WHEN s_ce.NORMALCY_CD IN (201, 203, 215) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RESULT_VALUE_IND,
  REPLACE(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(s_ce.RESULT_VAL, '>', '+'), '<', '-')), '\\\\', '\\') AS RESULT_VALUE,
  ar.ADE_NAME,
  s_ce.updt_dt_tm AS ods_process_dt_tm
FROM clinical_events AS s_ce
INNER JOIN orders AS s_o
  ON s_o.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
  AND s_o.ORDER_ID = s_ce.ORDER_ID
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.aci.dw_code_value AS cv
  ON cv.CODE_VALUE_HSS_ID = s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
  AND cv.CODE_VALUE_SK = s_ce.CATALOG_CD
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.aci.dw_code_value AS cv1
  ON cv1.CODE_VALUE_HSS_ID = s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
  AND cv1.CODE_VALUE_SK = s_ce.EVENT_CD
INNER JOIN ade_ref AS ar
  ON cv.DISPLAY = ar.LAB_PRIMARY_ORDERABLE
  AND (
    s_ce.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = ar.ade_hss_id
    OR ar.ade_hss_id IS NULL
  )
  AND (
    cv1.DISPLAY LIKE ar.LAB_EVENT_DISPLAY
    OR ar.LAB_EVENT_DISPLAY IS NULL
  );

-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL

 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS thcdnaproddata.aci.fact_ade_report2 AS
WITH
  ade_drug_base AS (
    -- Step 1: Isolate the small, initial set of filtered drug identifiers.
    SELECT
      dr.ADE_TYPE_SK,
      dr.ADE_NAME,
      dr.DRUG_NAME,
      dr.EVENT_NAME,
      dr.EVENT_TYPE,
      dr.DIM_ORDER_SK
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.ade_drug_identifier_tmp AS dr
    INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.aci.dim_ade_type AS a
      ON a.ADE_TYPE_DK = dr.ADE_TYPE_SK
    WHERE
      dr.MED_TYPE = 'M2'
  ),
  med_admin_filtered AS (
    -- Step 2: Filter the large `fact_medications_administration` table using the keys from above.
    -- Apply expensive REGEXP functions only on this smaller, filtered dataset.
    SELECT
      ma.FACT_MEDICATIONS_ADMINISTRATION_SK,
      ma.dim_dosage_measuring_units_sk,
      ma.dim_administering_personnel_sk,
      ma.dim_administering_location_sk,
      ma.dim_order_sk,
      ma.fact_order_sk,
      ma.begin_bag_flg,
      ma.dosage_quantity,
      ma.administer_ts,
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(ma.unique_id, r'[0-9]+', 1, 1) AS hss_id,
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(ma.unique_id, r'[0-9]+', 1, 2) AS event_id,
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(ma.unique_id, r'[0-9]+', 1, 3) AS clinical_event_id,
      dr.ADE_TYPE_SK,
      dr.ADE_NAME,
      dr.DRUG_NAME,
      dr.EVENT_NAME,
      dr.EVENT_TYPE
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.fact_medications_administration_tmp AS ma
    INNER JOIN ade_drug_base AS dr
      ON ma.DIM_ORDER_SK = dr.DIM_ORDER_SK
  ),
  order_filtered AS (
    -- Step 3: Filter the massive `fact_order` table using keys from the already-filtered `med_admin_filtered`.
    -- Apply expensive REGEXP functions here.
    SELECT
      o.FACT_ORDER_SK,
      o.dim_facility_sk,
      o.facility_cd,
      o.patient_account_nbr,
      o.TEMPLATE_ORDER_FLG,
      o.ORDER_ACTION_TS,
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(o.unique_id, r'[0-9]+', 1, 2) AS order_id,
      REGEXP_EXTRACT(o.unique_id, r'[0-9]+', 1, 1) AS hss_id
    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_order AS o
    INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fact_order_sk FROM med_admin_filtered) AS ma
      ON o.FACT_ORDER_SK = ma.fact_order_sk
  ),
  stg_ordering_physician AS (
    SELECT CAST(hss_id AS STRING) AS hss_id, CAST(order_id AS STRING) AS order_id, ordering_physician

  (CASE WHEN DATE_DIFF(ma.ADMINISTER_TS, p.DATE_OF_BIRTH, SECOND) / 31536000 < 18 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PEDIATRIC_PATIENT,

LEFT JOIN stg_ordering_physician AS stg ON stg.hss_id = o.hss_id AND stg.order_id = o.order_id

LEFT JOIN stg_nurse_unit_location AS stg2 ON stg2.hss_id = ma.hss_id AND stg2.event_id = ma.event_id AND stg2.clinical_event_id = ma.clinical_event_id
LEFT JOIN stg_admin_rn AS stg3 ON stg3.hss_id = ma.hss_id AND stg3.event_id = ma.event_id AND stg3.clinical_event_id = ma.clinical_event_id;

-- =================================================================================================
-- 4. Validation Step: Compare the two tables and check optimized duplicates.
-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View discrepancy rows.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES;

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

  ),

  ),

  ),
  exc_activity_type AS (

  ),
  exc_communication_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_encounter_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ENCOUNTER TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_medical_service AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'MEDICAL SERVICE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_order_short_desc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ORDER SHORT DESCRIPTION' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_ordering_physician AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_action_personnel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ACTION PERSONNEL' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  pos_unioned AS (
    SELECT ORDER_ID, HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORDERING_PERSONNEL, CS_FLAG
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_positions

    SELECT ORDER_ID, HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORDERING_PERSONNEL, CS_FLAG

      p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE, p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE, p.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC, p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN,
      p.BILL_ONLY_FLG, p.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR, p.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK,

      pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,

      CAST(0 AS INT64) AS CPOE_MED_RECON_POSITION_IND, -- Original logic for this column was commented out. Setting to a default to preserve schema.
      CASE 
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_physician_position) OR
               UPPER(p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER','DBA') OR
               UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_sub_type) OR

          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_ordering_physician) THEN 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN'

          ELSE 'NOT EXCEPTION'

       all_derived.ORDERING_PERSON AS ORDERING_PERSON_IDM,
   all_derived.ORDERING_PERSONNEL AS ORDERING_PERSON,
       all_derived.decode_ORDERING_PERSON,
       all_derived.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION AS ORDERING_PERSON_POSITION,
       CASE WHEN (UPPER(all_derived.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) = 'WRITTEN'
              AND UPPER(IFNULL(ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION,'')) in (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where LIST_EXCEP_NAME = 'CPOE Position List' )) THEN 'ENTERED ELECTRONICALLY BY PROVIDER'
                ELSE all_derived.COMMUNICATION_TYPE END AS ORDER_COMMUNICATION_TYPE,
       all_derived.ORDER_TYPE AS CLINICAL_CATEGORY,
       all_derived.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC AS ORDER_SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
       all_derived.ORDER_NM AS ORDER_MNEMONIC,
       all_derived.ORDER_DESC AS CLINICAL_DISPLAY_LINE,
       all_derived.ORDER_ID AS ORDER_ID,
       all_derived.POWER_PLAN AS POWER_PLAN_NAME,
       all_derived.POWER_PHASE AS PHASE_NAME,
       all_derived.CUSTOM_PLAN AS FAVORITES_PLAN_NAME,
       all_derived.ORDER_PLANNING_TS AS POWER_PLAN_DATE_TIME,
       all_derived.PLANNING_PERSON AS POWER_PLAN_PERSONNEL_IDM,
       all_derived.decode_PLANNING_PERSON,
       PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER AS POWER_PLAN_PERSONNEL_POSITION,
       all_derived.AUTH_NPI AS NPI,
       all_derived.AUTH_PHY_SPECIALITY AS PHYSICIAN_SPECIALTY,
       all_derived.COMMUNICATION_TYPE AS ORDER_CLINICAL_CATEGORY,
       HOSP_SERVICE_DESC AS MEDICAL_SERVICE,
       all_derived.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
       all_derived.ADMISSION_DT AS ADMIT_DATE,
       all_derived.ORDER_STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS,
       all_derived.ORDER_PLANNING_TS AS PLANNING_DATE_TIME,
       all_derived.CPOE_IND,
       all_derived.CPOE_POSITION_IND AS POSITION_IND,
       all_derived.CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND AS COMMUNICATION_IND,
       all_derived.ORDER_SOURCE,
       all_derived.CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND AS PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND,
       all_derived.CPOE_MED_RECON_POSITION_IND AS MED_RECON_POSITION_IND,
       CASE WHEN upper(COMMUNICATION_TYPE) in ('INITIAL PLAN','PROVIDER PLANNEN PLAN','INITIATE POWERPLAN PLANNED BY PROVIDER')
                 AND all_derived.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION not in ('RadNet: Film Librarian CPOE', 'RadNet: Mammo Tech CPOE','RadNet: Rad Tech CPOE','RadNet: RadTech/Transcription CPOE','RadNet: Supervisor CPOE','RadNet: Transcription CPOE')
                 AND UPPER(IFNULL(PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,'')) not in (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where LIST_EXCEP_NAME = 'CPOE Position List' )
                THEN CASE WHEN all_derived.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER is NOT NULL and (ORDER_SOURCE = 'FP' or ORDER_SOURCE = 'PP') Then 'Plan not Last Planned by a Provider - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
                      WHEN all_derived.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER is NULL and (ORDER_SOURCE = 'FP' or ORDER_SOURCE = 'PP') Then 'Plan not planned by a Provider - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
                      WHEN ORDER_SOURCE = 'CS' THEN 'Care Set Order - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
                      WHEN ORDER_SOURCE = 'SO' THEN 'Single Order - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
                 END
       END AS REASON_ON_REPORT,
       CPOE_EXCEPTION_IND EXCEPTION_IND,
       EXCEPTION_REASON,
       CASE WHEN FACILITY_CD IN ('BMA','MTB','NBH','NCA','SLH') AND CAST(IFNULL(NICU_DAYS,0) AS INT64) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NEWBORN_FLG END AS  NEWBORN_FLG,
       NICU_DAYS,
   AGEATADMISSION,
       MED_FLG
  FROM (
         SELECT *,
                CASE WHEN (CPOE_POSITION_IND = 1 or CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND = 1 or CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND = 1 ) then 1 else 0 end as CPOE_IND
           FROM (
                 select P.*,
                        POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN as ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
                        POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION as ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
                        POS.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN AS PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
                        POS.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
                POS.ORDERING_PERSONNEL,
                        POS.CS_FLAG,
                        CASE WHEN (P.DIM_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_SK <> '-99' or upper(ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) in (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where LIST_EXCEP_NAME = 'CPOE Position List' )) THEN 1 ELSE 0 end as CPOE_POSITION_IND,
                        CASE WHEN CASE WHEN upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) = 'EMERGENT TREATMENT PROTOCOL PRIOR TO' THEN 'EMERGENT TREATMENT PROTOCOL PRIOR TO ACKNOWLEDGEMENT' ELSE upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) END in (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where LIST_EXCEP_NAME = 'CPOE Communication List') THEN 1 ELSE 0 end as CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND,
                        CASE WHEN (P.DIM_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_SK <> '-99' or upper(POS.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) in (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where LIST_EXCEP_NAME = 'CPOE Position List' )) THEN 1 ELSE 0 end as CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND,
                        CASE WHEN (-- upper(P.ORDERING_PERSON) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.ACI.NZADMIN.CPOE_EXCEPTION_LIST where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTION PERSONNEL' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) OR
                                 upper(POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'PHYSICIAN POSITION' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                OR UPPER(ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER','DBA')
                                OR upper(P.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                OR upper(P.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTIVITY TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
--                                OR CASE WHEN P.FACILITY_CD NOT IN ('CSK','CHF','CSM') THEN DECODE (upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE),'ELECTRONIC','INCLUDE ELECTRONIC',upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) )
--                     ELSE upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) END IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) from CPOE_EXCEPTION_LIST where EXCEP_TYPE = 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                OR upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                OR upper(P.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ENCOUNTER TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                OR upper(P.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'MEDICAL SERVICE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                OR upper(P.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ORDER SHORT DESCRIPTION' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                OR upper(POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                OR ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL
                                OR P.BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1
                                OR P.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270
                              --OR (P.FACILITY_CD = 'SMH' AND MEDICAL_SERVICE = ''88 - Hemodialysis'' AND ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP IN (''4 - Recurring'', ''Recurring'') )
                                OR UPPER(ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%'
                OR upper(POS.ORDERING_PERSONNEL) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTION PERSONNEL' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0)
                                  )
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0 end as CPOE_EXCEPTION_IND,
                        CASE --WHEN upper(P.ORDERING_PERSON) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.ACI.NZADMIN.CPOE_EXCEPTION_LIST where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTION PERSONNEL' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'ACTION PERSONNEL'
                             WHEN upper(POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'PHYSICIAN POSITION' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'PHYSICIAN POSITION'
 WHEN UPPER(ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER','DBA') THEN 'STAFF POSITION'
                             WHEN upper(P.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE'
                             WHEN upper(P.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTIVITY TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'ACTIVITY TYPE'
--                             WHEN (CASE WHEN P.FACILITY_CD NOT IN ('CSK','CHF','CSM') THEN DECODE (upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE),'ELECTRONIC','INCLUDE ELECTRONIC',upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) )
--    ELSE upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) END) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) from CPOE_EXCEPTION_LIST where EXCEP_TYPE = 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'COMMUNICATION TYPE'
                             WHEN upper(P.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'COMMUNICATION TYPE'
                 WHEN upper(P.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ENCOUNTER TYPE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'ENCOUNTER TYPE'
                             WHEN upper(P.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'MEDICAL SERVICE' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'MEDICAL SERVICE'
                             WHEN upper(P.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ORDER SHORT DESCRIPTION' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'ORDERABLE'
                             WHEN upper(POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN'
                             WHEN ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL THEN 'NO ORDERING PHYSICIAN'
                             WHEN P.BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1 THEN 'BILL ONLY'
                             WHEN P.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270 THEN 'PHARMACY ORDER'
                             WHEN UPPER(ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%' THEN 'SYSTEM PHYSICIAN'
                 WHEN upper(POS.ORDERING_PERSONNEL) IN (select distinct upper(EXCEP_NAME) FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list where EXCEP_TYPE = 'ACTION PERSONNEL' and EXCEP_INCLUDE_FLAG = 0) THEN 'ORDERING PERSONNEL'
                        ELSE 'NOT EXCEPTION' END as EXCEPTION_REASON,
                        CASE WHEN P.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK <> -99 AND TRIM(IFNULL(P.CUSTOM_PLAN,'')) <> '' then 'FP'
                             WHEN P.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK <> -99 AND TRIM(IFNULL(P.POWER_PLAN,'')) <> '' then 'PP'
                             WHEN IFNULL(POS.CS_FLAG,0) <> 0 THEN 'CS'
                        ELSE 'SO' END AS ORDER_SOURCE,
                CASE WHEN UPPER(ORDER_NM) = 'ALERT!' AND UPPER(ORDER_TYPE) IN ('CONTINUOUS INFUSIONS','IV INFUSIONS','IV SOLUTIONS','MEDICATIONS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MED_FLG
                   FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_position_new P
                   LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_positions                                UNION ALL
                               SELECT * FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_positions_dmc                              )POS
                     on P.ORDER_ID = CAST(POS.ORDER_ID AS STRING)
                    and P.HSS_ID = CAST(POS.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AS STRING)
                ) derived
       ) all_derived;

-- =================================================================================================
-- 3. Create the Optimized Temporary Table (V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT)
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS
CREATE TABLE thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_dervd_new CLUSTER BY DIM_FACILITY_SK AS
WITH
  cpoe_position_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE list_excep_name = 'CPOE Position List'
  ),
  cpoe_communication_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE list_excep_name = 'CPOE Communication List'
  ),
  exc_physician_position AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'PHYSICIAN POSITION' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_activity_sub_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_activity_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ACTIVITY TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_communication_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_encounter_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ENCOUNTER TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_medical_service AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'MEDICAL SERVICE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_order_short_desc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ORDER SHORT DESCRIPTION' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_ordering_physician AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_action_personnel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ACTION PERSONNEL' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  pos_unioned AS (
    SELECT ORDER_ID, HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORDERING_PERSONNEL, CS_FLAG
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_positions
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ORDER_ID, HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORDERING_PERSONNEL, CS_FLAG
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_positions_dmc
  ),
  all_derived AS (
    SELECT
      p.FACT_ORDER_SK, p.DIM_FACILITY_SK, p.FACILITY_CD, p.HSS_ID, p.NURSING_UNIT,
      p.LOCATION_DESC, p.ORDER_ACTION_TS, p.PATIENT_CLASS_CD, p.AUTH_PHYSICIAN, p.ORDERING_PERSON,
      p.decode_ORDERING_PERSON, p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION, p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE, p.ORDER_TYPE, p.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC,
      p.ORDER_NM, p.ORDER_DESC, p.ORDER_ID, p.POWER_PLAN, p.POWER_PHASE, p.CUSTOM_PLAN,
      p.ORDER_PLANNING_TS, p.PLANNING_PERSON, p.decode_PLANNING_PERSON, p.AUTH_NPI, p.AUTH_PHY_SPECIALITY,
      p.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC, p.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, p.ADMISSION_DT, p.ORDER_STATUS, p.NEWBORN_FLG,
      p.NICU_DAYS, p.AGEATADMISSION, p.DIM_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_SK, p.DIM_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_SK,
      p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE, p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE, p.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC, p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN,
      p.BILL_ONLY_FLG, p.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR, p.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK,
      pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN AS ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
      pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
      pos.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN AS PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
      pos.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
      pos.ORDERING_PERSONNEL,
      pos.CS_FLAG,
      CAST(p.DIM_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_SK <> '-99' OR UPPER(p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_position_list) AS INT64) AS CPOE_POSITION_IND,
      CAST(CASE WHEN UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) = 'EMERGENT TREATMENT PROTOCOL PRIOR TO' THEN 'EMERGENT TREATMENT PROTOCOL PRIOR TO ACKNOWLEDGEMENT' ELSE UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) END IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_communication_list) AS INT64) AS CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND,
      CAST(p.DIM_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_SK <> '-99' OR UPPER(pos.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_position_list) AS INT64) AS CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND,
      CAST(0 AS INT64) AS CPOE_MED_RECON_POSITION_IND, -- Original logic for this column was commented out. Setting to a default to preserve schema.
      CASE 
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_physician_position) OR
               UPPER(p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER','DBA') OR
               UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_sub_type) OR
               UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_type) OR
               UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_communication_type) OR
               UPPER(p.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_encounter_type) OR
               UPPER(p.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_medical_service) OR
               UPPER(p.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_order_short_desc) OR
               UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_ordering_physician) OR
               p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL OR
               p.BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1 OR
               p.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270 OR
               UPPER(p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%' OR
               UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PERSONNEL) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_action_personnel)
          THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END AS CPOE_EXCEPTION_IND,
      CASE 
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_physician_position) THEN 'PHYSICIAN POSITION'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER','DBA') THEN 'STAFF POSITION'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_sub_type) THEN 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_type) THEN 'ACTIVITY TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_communication_type) THEN 'COMMUNICATION TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_encounter_type) THEN 'ENCOUNTER TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_medical_service) THEN 'MEDICAL SERVICE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_order_short_desc) THEN 'ORDERABLE'
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_ordering_physician) THEN 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN'
          WHEN p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL THEN 'NO ORDERING PHYSICIAN'
          WHEN p.BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1 THEN 'BILL ONLY'
          WHEN p.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270 THEN 'PHARMACY ORDER'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%' THEN 'SYSTEM PHYSICIAN'
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PERSONNEL) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_action_personnel) THEN 'ORDERING PERSONNEL'
          ELSE 'NOT EXCEPTION'
      END AS EXCEPTION_REASON,
      CASE 
          WHEN p.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK <> -99 AND TRIM(IFNULL(p.CUSTOM_PLAN,'')) <> '' THEN 'FP'
          WHEN p.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK <> -99 AND TRIM(IFNULL(p.POWER_PLAN,'')) <> '' THEN 'PP'
          WHEN IFNULL(pos.CS_FLAG,0) <> 0 THEN 'CS'
          ELSE 'SO'
      END AS ORDER_SOURCE
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_position_new AS p
    LEFT JOIN pos_unioned AS pos
      ON p.ORDER_ID = CAST(pos.ORDER_ID AS STRING)
      AND p.HSS_ID = CAST(pos.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AS STRING)
  )
SELECT
  d.FACT_ORDER_SK,
  d.DIM_FACILITY_SK,
  d.FACILITY_CD,
  d.HSS_ID,
  d.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
  d.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
  d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
  d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
  d.CS_FLAG,
  d.NURSING_UNIT,
  d.LOCATION_DESC AS ORDERING_NURSING_UNIT,
  d.ORDER_ACTION_TS AS ORDER_DATE_TIME,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(d.LOCATION_DESC) IN ('BMA - ALD SEL SP LTAC-D','BMA - ALC SEL SP HSP LTAC') THEN 'O' ELSE d.PATIENT_CLASS_CD END AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE,
  d.AUTH_PHYSICIAN AS ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_IDM,
  d.ORDERING_PERSON AS ORDERING_PERSON_IDM,
  d.ORDERING_PERSONNEL AS ORDERING_PERSON,
  d.decode_ORDERING_PERSON,
  d.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION AS ORDERING_PERSON_POSITION,
  CASE WHEN (UPPER(d.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) = 'WRITTEN'
         AND UPPER(IFNULL(d.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION,'')) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_position_list)) THEN 'ENTERED ELECTRONICALLY BY PROVIDER'
           ELSE d.COMMUNICATION_TYPE END AS ORDER_COMMUNICATION_TYPE,
  d.ORDER_TYPE AS CLINICAL_CATEGORY,
  d.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC AS ORDER_SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
  d.ORDER_NM AS ORDER_MNEMONIC,
  d.ORDER_DESC AS CLINICAL_DISPLAY_LINE,
  d.ORDER_ID AS ORDER_ID,
  d.POWER_PLAN AS POWER_PLAN_NAME,
  d.POWER_PHASE AS PHASE_NAME,
  d.CUSTOM_PLAN AS FAVORITES_PLAN_NAME,
  d.ORDER_PLANNING_TS AS POWER_PLAN_DATE_TIME,
  d.PLANNING_PERSON AS POWER_PLAN_PERSONNEL_IDM,
  d.decode_PLANNING_PERSON,
  d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER AS POWER_PLAN_PERSONNEL_POSITION,
  d.AUTH_NPI AS NPI,
  d.AUTH_PHY_SPECIALITY AS PHYSICIAN_SPECIALTY,
  d.COMMUNICATION_TYPE AS ORDER_CLINICAL_CATEGORY,
  d.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC AS MEDICAL_SERVICE,
  d.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
  d.ADMISSION_DT AS ADMIT_DATE,
  d.ORDER_STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS,
  d.ORDER_PLANNING_TS AS PLANNING_DATE_TIME,
  CAST((d.CPOE_POSITION_IND = 1 OR d.CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND = 1 OR d.CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND = 1) AS INT64) AS CPOE_IND,
  d.CPOE_POSITION_IND AS POSITION_IND,
  d.CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND AS COMMUNICATION_IND,
  d.ORDER_SOURCE,
  d.CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND AS PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND,
  d.CPOE_MED_RECON_POSITION_IND AS MED_RECON_POSITION_IND,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(d.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN ('INITIAL PLAN','PROVIDER PLANNEN PLAN','INITIATE POWERPLAN PLANNED BY PROVIDER')
            AND d.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION NOT IN ('RadNet: Film Librarian CPOE', 'RadNet: Mammo Tech CPOE','RadNet: Rad Tech CPOE','RadNet: RadTech/Transcription CPOE','RadNet: Supervisor CPOE','RadNet: Transcription CPOE')
            AND UPPER(IFNULL(d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,'')) NOT IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_position_list)
           THEN CASE 
              WHEN d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER IS NOT NULL AND (d.ORDER_SOURCE = 'FP' OR d.ORDER_SOURCE = 'PP') THEN 'Plan not Last Planned by a Provider - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
              WHEN d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER IS NULL AND (d.ORDER_SOURCE = 'FP' OR d.ORDER_SOURCE = 'PP') THEN 'Plan not planned by a Provider - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
              WHEN d.ORDER_SOURCE = 'CS' THEN 'Care Set Order - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
              WHEN d.ORDER_SOURCE = 'SO' THEN 'Single Order - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
           END
  END AS REASON_ON_REPORT,
  d.CPOE_EXCEPTION_IND AS EXCEPTION_IND,
  d.EXCEPTION_REASON,
  CASE WHEN d.FACILITY_CD IN ('BMA','MTB','NBH','NCA','SLH') AND CAST(IFNULL(d.NICU_DAYS,0) AS INT64) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE d.NEWBORN_FLG END AS NEWBORN_FLG,
  d.NICU_DAYS,
  d.AGEATADMISSION,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(d.ORDER_NM) = 'ALERT!' AND UPPER(d.ORDER_TYPE) IN ('CONTINUOUS INFUSIONS','IV INFUSIONS','IV SOLUTIONS','MEDICATIONS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MED_FLG
FROM all_derived AS d;

-- =================================================================================================
-- 4. Validation Step: Compare the two tables and check optimized duplicates.
-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View discrepancy rows.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES;

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

/*

SET V_TEST = I_TEST;
*/

-- Drop CPOE_POSITION_NEW table before running new calculation

CREATE TABLE thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_position_new AS
select
       o.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,

       e.DISCHARGE_NURSING_UNIT NURSING_UNIT,
       DIM_LOCATION.LOCATION_DESC,

       CASE WHEN (IFNULL(DPLANP.LAST_NM,'') ||' '|| IFNULL(DPLANP.FIRST_NM,'') || ' '||IFNULL(DPLANP.MIDDLE_NM,'')) = ' ' THEN plan_pos.PERSONNEL_FULL_NAME ELSE (DPLANP.LAST_NM ||' '|| DPLANP.FIRST_NM || ' '||DPLANP.MIDDLE_NM) END decode_PLANNING_PERSON,

       o.DIM_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_SK,
       DAUTHP.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID_NBR AUTH_NPI,
       DAUTHP.PHYSICIAN_SPECIALTY_DESC AUTH_PHY_SPECIALITY,
       IFNULL(DAUTHP.LAST_NM,'')||' '|| IFNULL(DAUTHP.FIRST_NM,'')|| ' '|| IFNULL(DAUTHP.MIDDLE_NM,'') AUTH_PHYSICIAN,
       IFNULL(DP.LAST_NM,'') || IFNULL(DP.FIRST_NM,'') || IFNULL(DP.MIDDLE_NM,'') A, pos.PERSONNEL_FULL_NAME ORDER_PHYSICIAN,
       NULL AS CPOE_MED_RECON_POSITION_IND,
       act_type.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE,
       act_type.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE,
       de.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC,
       hosp_serv.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC,
       o.BILL_ONLY_FLG,
       o.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR
  from /*(SELECT *
          FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_order          WHERE FACILITY_CD IN ('CHF','CSK','CSM','DCR','DDR','DHR','DHV','DHY','DSH','BMA','MTB','NBH','NCA','SLH')
           AND ORDER_ACTION_TS > '2017-01-01'
         UNION ALL
        SELECT *
          FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_order          WHERE FACILITY_CD NOT IN ('CHF','CSK','CSM','DCR','DDR','DHR','DHV','DHY','DSH','BMA','MTB','NBH','NCA','SLH')
       ) o*/
      -- FACT_ORDER o
      thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_order o
  JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_order dor
    on dor.DIM_ORDER_SK = o.DIM_ORDER_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_encounter e
    on o.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = e.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
   and o.FACILITY_CD = e.FACILITY_CD
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_encounter_type de
    on e.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK = de.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK
  LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_patient dpat
    ON e.dim_patient_sk = dpat.dim_patient_sk
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_personnel pos
    on o.DIM_ORDERING_PERSONNEL_SK = pos.DIM_PERSONNEL_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_physician DP
    ON o.DIM_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_SK = DP.DIM_PHYSICIAN_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_personnel plan_pos
    on o.DIM_PLANNING_PERSONNEL_SK = plan_pos.DIM_PERSONNEL_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_physician DAUTHP
    ON o.DIM_AUTHORIZING_PHYSICIAN_SK = DAUTHP.DIM_PHYSICIAN_SK
  LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_physician DPLANP
    ON o.DIM_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_SK = DPLANP.DIM_PHYSICIAN_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_order_activity_type act_type
    on o.DIM_ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE_SK = act_type.DIM_ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_communication_type c
    on o.DIM_ORDER_COMMUNICATION_TYPE_SK = c.DIM_COMMUNICATION_TYPE_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_hospital_service hosp_serv
    on e.DIM_HOSP_SERVICE_SK = hosp_serv.DIM_HOSP_SERVICE_SK
  left JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_power_plan pwr
    on o.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK = pwr.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK

  LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_location     ON o.DIM_ORDER_LOCATION_SK  = DIM_LOCATION.DIM_LOCATION_SK
 where
 CAST(o.ORDER_ACTION_TS AS date) between DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE("America/Chicago"),INTERVAL 24 MONTH),YEAR) AND LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE("America/Chicago"),INTERVAL 1 MONTH))
   and o.TEMPLATE_ORDER_FLG not in (4,2)
   and o.ORIGINAL_ORDER_FLG = 0
   AND NOT (UPPER(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE 'ZZTEST%'
                OR UPPER(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE 'ZZZTEST%'
                OR UPPER(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE 'ZZLEAPFROG%'
                OR UPPER(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE 'ZZZLEAPFROG%'
                OR UPPER(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE 'LEAPFROG%'
                OR upper(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE '%TEST'
                OR upper(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE '%TESTING'
                OR upper(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE '%LEAPFROG%'
                OR upper(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE '%CAPSURVEY%'
                OR upper(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE '%TESTPATIENT%'
                OR upper(dpat.FIRST_NM || ' ' || dpat.LAST_NM) LIKE '%TESTINGP%'
           )
;

-- Drop CPOE_DERVD_NEW table before running new calculation

-- START OPTIMIZED QUERY
CREATE TABLE thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_dervd_new CLUSTER BY DIM_FACILITY_SK AS
WITH
  cpoe_position_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE list_excep_name = 'CPOE Position List'
  ),
  cpoe_communication_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE list_excep_name = 'CPOE Communication List'
  ),
  exc_physician_position AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'PHYSICIAN POSITION' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_activity_sub_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_activity_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ACTIVITY TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_communication_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_encounter_type AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ENCOUNTER TYPE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_medical_service AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'MEDICAL SERVICE' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_order_short_desc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ORDER SHORT DESCRIPTION' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_ordering_physician AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  exc_action_personnel AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(excep_name) AS excep_name FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_exception_list WHERE excep_type = 'ACTION PERSONNEL' AND excep_include_flag = 0
  ),
  pos_unioned AS (
    SELECT ORDER_ID, HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORDERING_PERSONNEL, CS_FLAG
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_positions
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ORDER_ID, HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORDERING_PERSONNEL, CS_FLAG
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_positions_dmc
  ),
  all_derived AS (
    SELECT
      p.FACT_ORDER_SK, p.DIM_FACILITY_SK, p.FACILITY_CD, p.HSS_ID, p.NURSING_UNIT,
      p.LOCATION_DESC, p.ORDER_ACTION_TS, p.PATIENT_CLASS_CD, p.AUTH_PHYSICIAN, p.ORDERING_PERSON,
      p.decode_ORDERING_PERSON, p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION, p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE, p.ORDER_TYPE, p.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC,
      p.ORDER_NM, p.ORDER_DESC, p.ORDER_ID, p.POWER_PLAN, p.POWER_PHASE, p.CUSTOM_PLAN,
      p.ORDER_PLANNING_TS, p.PLANNING_PERSON, p.decode_PLANNING_PERSON, p.AUTH_NPI, p.AUTH_PHY_SPECIALITY,
      p.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC, p.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, p.ADMISSION_DT, p.ORDER_STATUS, p.NEWBORN_FLG,
      p.NICU_DAYS, p.AGEATADMISSION, p.DIM_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_SK, p.DIM_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_SK,
      p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE, p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE, p.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC, p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN,
      p.BILL_ONLY_FLG, p.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR, p.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK,
      pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN AS ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
      pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
      pos.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN AS PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
      pos.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
      pos.ORDERING_PERSONNEL,
      pos.CS_FLAG,
      CAST(p.DIM_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_SK <> '-99' OR UPPER(p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_position_list) AS INT64) AS CPOE_POSITION_IND,
      CAST(CASE WHEN UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) = 'EMERGENT TREATMENT PROTOCOL PRIOR TO' THEN 'EMERGENT TREATMENT PROTOCOL PRIOR TO ACKNOWLEDGEMENT' ELSE UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) END IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_communication_list) AS INT64) AS CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND,
      CAST(p.DIM_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_SK <> '-99' OR UPPER(pos.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_position_list) AS INT64) AS CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND,
      CAST(0 AS INT64) AS CPOE_MED_RECON_POSITION_IND, -- Original logic for this column was commented out. Setting to a default to preserve schema.
      CASE 
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_physician_position) OR
               UPPER(p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER','DBA') OR
               UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_sub_type) OR
               UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_type) OR
               UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_communication_type) OR
               UPPER(p.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_encounter_type) OR
               UPPER(p.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_medical_service) OR
               UPPER(p.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_order_short_desc) OR
               UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_ordering_physician) OR
               p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL OR
               p.BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1 OR
               p.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270 OR
               UPPER(p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%' OR
               UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PERSONNEL) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_action_personnel)
          THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END AS CPOE_EXCEPTION_IND,
      CASE 
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_physician_position) THEN 'PHYSICIAN POSITION'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER','DBA') THEN 'STAFF POSITION'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_sub_type) THEN 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDER_ACTIVITY_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_activity_type) THEN 'ACTIVITY TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_communication_type) THEN 'COMMUNICATION TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.PATIENT_CLASS_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_encounter_type) THEN 'ENCOUNTER TYPE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.HOSP_SERVICE_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_medical_service) THEN 'MEDICAL SERVICE'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_order_short_desc) THEN 'ORDERABLE'
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_ordering_physician) THEN 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN'
          WHEN p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL THEN 'NO ORDERING PHYSICIAN'
          WHEN p.BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1 THEN 'BILL ONLY'
          WHEN p.ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270 THEN 'PHARMACY ORDER'
          WHEN UPPER(p.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%' THEN 'SYSTEM PHYSICIAN'
          WHEN UPPER(pos.ORDERING_PERSONNEL) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM exc_action_personnel) THEN 'ORDERING PERSONNEL'
          ELSE 'NOT EXCEPTION'
      END AS EXCEPTION_REASON,
      CASE 
          WHEN p.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK <> -99 AND TRIM(IFNULL(p.CUSTOM_PLAN,'')) <> '' THEN 'FP'
          WHEN p.DIM_POWER_PLAN_SK <> -99 AND TRIM(IFNULL(p.POWER_PLAN,'')) <> '' THEN 'PP'
          WHEN IFNULL(pos.CS_FLAG,0) <> 0 THEN 'CS'
          ELSE 'SO'
      END AS ORDER_SOURCE
    FROM thcdnaproddata.aci.cpoe_position_new AS p
    LEFT JOIN pos_unioned AS pos
      ON p.ORDER_ID = CAST(pos.ORDER_ID AS STRING)
      AND p.HSS_ID = CAST(pos.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AS STRING)
  )
SELECT
  d.FACT_ORDER_SK,
  d.DIM_FACILITY_SK,
  d.FACILITY_CD,
  d.HSS_ID,
  d.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
  d.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
  d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_CERNER,
  d.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION_CERNER,
  d.CS_FLAG,
  d.NURSING_UNIT,
  d.LOCATION_DESC AS ORDERING_NURSING_UNIT,
  d.ORDER_ACTION_TS AS ORDER_DATE_TIME,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(d.LOCATION_DESC) IN ('BMA - ALD SEL SP LTAC-D','BMA - ALC SEL SP HSP LTAC') THEN 'O' ELSE d.PATIENT_CLASS_CD END AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE,
  d.AUTH_PHYSICIAN AS ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_IDM,
  d.ORDERING_PERSON AS ORDERING_PERSON_IDM,
  d.ORDERING_PERSONNEL AS ORDERING_PERSON,
  d.decode_ORDERING_PERSON,
  d.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION AS ORDERING_PERSON_POSITION,
  CASE WHEN (UPPER(d.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) = 'WRITTEN'
         AND UPPER(IFNULL(d.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION,'')) IN (SELECT excep_name FROM cpoe_position_list)) THEN 'ENTERED ELECTRONICALLY BY PROVIDER'
           ELSE d.COMMUNICATION_TYPE END AS ORDER_COMMUNICATION_TYPE,
  d.ORDER_TYPE AS CLINICAL_CATEGORY,
  d.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC AS ORDER_SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
  d.ORDER_NM AS ORDER_MNEMONIC,
  d.ORDER_DESC AS CLINICAL_DISPLAY_LINE,
  d.ORDER_ID AS ORDER_ID,
  d.POWER_PLAN AS POWER_PLAN_NAME,
  d.POWER_PHASE AS PHASE_NAME,
  d.CUSTOM_PLAN AS FAVORITES_PLAN_NAME,
  d.ORDER_PLANNING_TS AS POWER_PLAN_DATE_TIME,
  d.PLANNING_PERSON AS POWER_PLAN_PERSONNEL_IDM,

-- 4. Validation Step: Compare the two tables and check optimized duplicates.
-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View discrepancy rows.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES;

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

OUTT.ENCOUNTER_SK,

( SELECT INN.ORDER_HSS_ID,

MAX(S_LH1.ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID) AS MAX_ENCNTR_LOC_ID
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH1,
( SELECT D_O4.ORDER_HSS_ID ORDER_HSS_ID,
D_O4.ENCNTR_ID ENCOUNTER_SK,
D_O4.ORDER_SK,
MAX(S_LH0.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM) AS MAX_BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM,
D_O4.ORIG_ORDER_DT_TM

ON S_LH0.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = D_O4.ORDER_HSS_ID

AND S_LH0.END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM > D_O4.ACTION_DT_TM

AND S_LH1.END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM > INN.ORIG_ORDER_DT_TM

AND CV2.CODE_VALUE = LOC.ORDER_UNIT_SK
AND CV2.ACTIVE_IND = 1
--AND CV2.CURRENT_IND = 1

SELECT ENC.* ,SUBSTR(FACILITY_DISPLAY,1,3) FACILITY_CD
,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(FACILITY_DISPLAY,1,3) in('BMA','MTB','NBH','NCA','SLH') THEN IFNULL(DV2.V7NICU,0) ELSE IFNULL(DV1.V7NICU,0) END as NICU_DAYS
FROM
(
SELECT S_E.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
,S_E.ENCNTR_ID
,S_E.ARRIVE_DT_TM
,S_E.DISCH_DT_TM
,S_EA1.ALIAS AS FIN_NBR
,MRN_ALIAS_FIN.ALIAS AS MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR
,CV_FACILITY.DISPLAY FACILITY_DISPLAY
,CV1.DISPLAY AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP
,CV2.DESCRIPTION AS MEDICAL_SERVICE_DISP
,S_E.ENCNTR_TYPE_CD
, CASE WHEN S_E.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = 80048 THEN
CASE WHEN S_E.ADMIT_TYPE_CD = 5610 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE
CASE WHEN S_E.ADMIT_TYPE_CD = 670841 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS NEWBORN_FLAG
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encounter_hist S_E
INNER JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_alias_hist S_EA1
ON S_EA1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = S_E.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
S_EA1.ENCNTR_ID = S_E.ENCNTR_ID AND
S_EA1.ACTIVE_IND = 1 AND
--S_EA1.CURRENT_IND = 1 AND
S_EA1.END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM > CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago") AND
(S_EA1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID <> 80048 AND S_EA1.ENCNTR_ALIAS_TYPE_CD = 1077)
AND IFNULL(S_E.DISCH_DT_TM,S_E.UPDT_DT_TM) >=DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE("America/Chicago"), INTERVAL 24 MONTH), YEAR)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
ENCNTR_ID,
ALIAS
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_alias_hist
WHERE ACTIVE_IND = 1 AND --CURRENT_IND = 1 AND
END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM > CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago") AND
ENCNTR_ALIAS_TYPE_CD = 1079
) MRN_ALIAS_FIN
ON MRN_ALIAS_FIN.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = S_E.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
MRN_ALIAS_FIN.ENCNTR_ID = S_E.ENCNTR_ID
JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV_FACILITY
ON S_E.LOC_FACILITY_CD = CV_FACILITY.CODE_VALUE
AND S_E.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = CV_FACILITY.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV1
ON CV1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = S_E.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
CV1.CODE_VALUE = S_E.ENCNTR_TYPE_CD AND
CV1.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND CV1.CURRENT_IND = 1
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV2
ON CV2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = S_E.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
CV2.CODE_VALUE = S_E.MED_SERVICE_CD AND
CV2.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND CV2.CURRENT_IND = 1
WHERE CV_FACILITY.DISPLAY NOT IN ('SJH BH','SMY BH','SMY BHSUB')
AND S_EA1.ALIAS IS NOT NULL --20211021
) ENC
LEFT JOIN daac_ods.daac_visit_hist DV1
ON TRIM(DV1.V7HOSP) = TRIM(SUBSTR(ENC.FACILITY_DISPLAY,1,3)) AND
TRIM(CAST(DV1.V7PAT AS STRING)) = TRIM(ENC.FIN_NBR)
--AND DV1.CURRENT_IND = 1
LEFT JOIN daac_ods.non_pbar_visit_hist DV2
ON TRIM(DV2.V7HOSP) = TRIM(SUBSTR(ENC.FACILITY_DISPLAY,1,3)) AND
TRIM(CAST(DV2.V7PAT AS STRING) )= TRIM(ENC.FIN_NBR)
--AND DV2.CURRENT_IND = 1
--WHERE FACILITY_CD IN ('DHF','DHW','FRH','HAH','LPX','SCH')
;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS aci.cpoe_unit_admit;


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aci.cpoe_unit_admit AS
SELECT ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,ENCOUNTER_SK, CV1.DISPLAY ADMIT_LOCATION , CV2.DISPLAY ADMIT_UNIT, CV2.DESCRIPTION as UNIT_DESC
FROM (
SELECT OUTT.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
OUTT.ENCOUNTER_SK,
S_LH.LOCATION_CD AS ADMIT_LOCATION_SK,
S_LH.LOC_FACILITY_CD AS ADMIT_FACILITY_SK,
S_LH.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD AS ADMIT_UNIT_SK
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH,
(SELECT INN.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
INN.ENCOUNTER_SK,
MAX(S_LH1.ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID) AS MIN_ENCNTR_LOC_ID
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH1,
(SELECT S_LH0.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
S_LH0.ENCNTR_ID ENCOUNTER_SK,
MAX(S_LH0.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM) AS MIN_BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH0
WHERE S_LH0.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND S_LH0.CURRENT_IND = 1
GROUP BY S_LH0.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
S_LH0.ENCNTR_ID
) INN
WHERE S_LH1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = INN.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
S_LH1.ENCNTR_ID = INN.ENCOUNTER_SK AND
S_LH1.ACTIVE_IND = 1 AND
--S_LH1.CURRENT_IND = 1 AND
S_LH1.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM = INN.MIN_BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
GROUP BY INN.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
INN.ENCOUNTER_SK
) OUTT
WHERE S_LH.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = OUTT.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
S_LH.ENCNTR_ID = OUTT.ENCOUNTER_SK AND
S_LH.ACTIVE_IND = 1 AND
--S_LH.CURRENT_IND = 1 AND
S_LH.ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID = OUTT.MIN_ENCNTR_LOC_ID
) LOC
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV1
ON CV1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = LOC.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
CV1.CODE_VALUE = LOC.ADMIT_LOCATION_SK AND
CV1.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND CV1.CURRENT_IND = 1

LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV2
ON CV2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = LOC.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
CV2.CODE_VALUE = LOC.ADMIT_UNIT_SK AND
CV2.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND CV2.CURRENT_IND = 1
;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aci.fact_order_temp_order_proposal_stg CLUSTER BY HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,ORDER_ID AS
(SELECT B.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,B.ORDER_ID,B.ORDER_PROPOSAL_ID,B.CREATED_DT_TM,B.ENTERED_BY_PRSNL_ID

(
SELECT HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,ORDER_ID,ORDER_PROPOSAL_ID,CREATED_DT_TM,
PROPOSAL_SOURCE_TYPE_CD,PROPOSAL_STATUS_CD,ENTERED_BY_PRSNL_ID,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,ORDER_ID

SELECT B.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,B.ORDER_ID,B.ORDER_PROPOSAL_ID,B.CREATED_DT_TM ,B.PROPOSAL_SOURCE_TYPE_CD,
B.PROPOSAL_STATUS_CD,B.ENTERED_BY_PRSNL_ID

PROPOSAL_FROM_ACTION_SEQ = 0
AND UPDT_DT_TM >=DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE("America/Chicago"), INTERVAL 24 MONTH), YEAR) --20211021
) B

cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV1 ON
B.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID=CV1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
AND B.PROPOSAL_SOURCE_TYPE_CD=CV1.CODE_VALUE
AND CV1.CODE_SET = 6502 AND
TRIM(CV1.CDF_MEANING) = 'CHANGEVENUE' AND
CV1.ACTIVE_IND = 1

cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV2 ON
B.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID=CV2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
AND B.PROPOSAL_STATUS_CD=CV2.CODE_VALUE AND CV2.CODE_SET = 6501 AND
TRIM(CV2.CDF_MEANING) = 'ACCEPTED' AND
CV2.ACTIVE_IND = 1
--CV2.CURRENT_IND = 1
) A
) B
WHERE RANK=1
);

ACTION_HIST.ORDER_APP_NBR AS ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR,
ACTION_HIST.ACTION_PERSONNEL_ID ,
ACTION_HIST.ACTION_DT_TM ,
ACTION_HIST.ORDER_PROVIDER_ID,

ORDER_COM_TYPE.DISPLAY AS COMMUNICATION_TYPE,

ORDER_SYSTEM_DISCONTINUE_FLG.DISPLAY AS DISCONTINUE_DISP,

D.CUSTOM_PLAN_DESC,
D.POWER_PLAN_DESC,
D.POWER_PHASE_DESC,

D.PLANNING_DT_TM,
ORDER_STATUS_CD.DISPLAY AS STATUS,--NEEDED
IFNULL(ORDER_CATALOG_SYNONYM.MNEMONIC,'N/A') AS ORDER_NM,
IFNULL(CODE_VALUE.DISPLAY,'N/A') AS ORDER_TYPE,
IFNULL(CODE_VALUE1.DISPLAY,'N/A') AS ORDER_CATALOG_TYPE,
IFNULL(ORDER_CATALOG.DESCRIPTION,'N/A') AS ORDER_CATALOG_DESC,
ORDER_CATALOG.BILL_ONLY_IND AS BILL_ONLY_FLG,
UPPER(IFNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(CODE_VALUE2.DISPLAY)),'N/A')) AS ACTIVITY_TYPE,
UPPER(IFNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(CODE_VALUE3.DISPLAY)),'N/A')) AS ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE,

aci.fact_order_temp_order_stg ORDERS

ON
ORDERS.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = ACTION_HIST.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
AND ORDERS.ORDER_ID = ACTION_HIST.ORDER_ID

AND ORDERS.ORDER_ID=D.PARENT_ENTITY_ID

ORDER_SYSTEM_DISCONTINUE_FLG.CODE_SET = 4038
--ORDER_SYSTEM_DISCONTINUE_FLG.CURRENT_IND = 1
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist ORDER_MED_ROUTE
ON
ORDER_MED_ROUTE.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = ORDERS.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
ORDER_MED_ROUTE.CODE_VALUE = ORDERS.MED_ORDER_TYPE_CD AND
ORDER_MED_ROUTE.CODE_SET = 18309
--ORDER_MED_ROUTE.CURRENT_IND = 1
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist ORDER_STATUS_CD
ON
ORDER_STATUS_CD.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = ORDERS.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
ORDER_STATUS_CD.CODE_VALUE = ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS_CD AND
ORDER_STATUS_CD.CODE_SET = 6004
--ORDER_STATUS_CD.CURRENT_IND = 1
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_order_catalog_hist ORDER_CATALOG
ON
ORDER_CATALOG.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = ORDERS.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
ORDER_CATALOG.CATALOG_CD = ORDERS.CATALOG_CD
--ORDER_CATALOG.CURRENT_IND = 1

ON ORDER_CATALOG.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = CODE_VALUE2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
AND ORDER_CATALOG.ACTIVITY_TYPE_CD = CODE_VALUE2.CODE_VALUE
AND CODE_VALUE2.ACTIVE_IND=1
AND CODE_VALUE2.CODE_SET=106

FROM cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist
WHERE ACTIVE_IND=1
AND CODE_SET=5801
) CODE_VALUE3
ON ORDER_CATALOG.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = CODE_VALUE3.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
AND ORDER_CATALOG.ACTIVITY_SUBTYPE_CD = CODE_VALUE3.CODE_VALUE
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_order_catalog_synonym_hist ORDER_CATALOG_SYNONYM
ON
ORDER_CATALOG_SYNONYM.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = ORDERS.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
ORDER_CATALOG_SYNONYM.SYNONYM_ID = ORDERS.SYNONYM_ID
--ORDER_CATALOG_SYNONYM.CURRENT_IND = 1
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CODE_VALUE

AND ORDERS.DCP_CLIN_CAT_CD = CODE_VALUE.CODE_VALUE
AND CODE_VALUE.ACTIVE_IND=1
AND CODE_VALUE.CODE_SET=16389

AND ORDERS.CATALOG_TYPE_CD = CODE_VALUE1.CODE_VALUE
AND CODE_VALUE1.ACTIVE_IND=1
AND CODE_VALUE1.CODE_SET=6000

ORDER_COM_TYPE.CODE_VALUE = ACTION_HIST.COMMUNICATION_TYPE_CD AND
ORDER_COM_TYPE.CODE_SET = 6006
--ORDER_COM_TYPE.CURRENT_IND = 1

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS aci.order_unit_temp; --20211021

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aci.order_unit_temp AS
SELECT * FROM
(
SELECT P.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORDER_HSS_ID,ORDER_SK ORDER BY ODS_PROCESS_DT_TM DESC NULLS LAST) PICK_1
FROM (SELECT S_O.*,
S_O.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AS ORDER_HSS_ID,
S_O.ORDER_ID AS ORDER_SK,
S_OA.ACTION_DT_TM,
(CASE WHEN (S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM > S_O.UPDT_DT_TM AND
S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM IS NOT NULL ) THEN S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM
ELSE S_O.UPDT_DT_TM END) AS ODS_PROCESS_DT_TM
FROM (SELECT *
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_orders_hist
WHERE ORIG_ORDER_DT_TM >= DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE("America/Chicago"), INTERVAL 24 MONTH), YEAR) --20211210
) S_O
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_order_action_hist S_OA
ON S_OA.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = S_O.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND
S_OA.ORDER_ID = S_O.ORDER_ID AND
S_OA.ACTION_TYPE_CD = 2534
--S_OA.CURRENT_IND = 1
WHERE --S_O.CURRENT_IND = 1 AND
S_O.TEMPLATE_ORDER_FLAG IN (0,1,5) AND
S_O.ORIG_ORD_AS_FLAG IN (0,1,2)
) P
) OO
WHERE OO.PICK_1=1;

FROM (
SELECT OUTT.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
OUTT.ENCOUNTER_SK,
S_LH.LOCATION_CD AS ADMIT_LOCATION_SK,
S_LH.LOC_FACILITY_CD AS ADMIT_FACILITY_SK,
S_LH.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD AS ADMIT_UNIT_SK
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH,
(SELECT INN.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
INN.ENCOUNTER_SK,
MAX(S_LH1.ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID) AS MIN_ENCNTR_LOC_ID
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH1,
(SELECT S_LH0.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
S_LH0.ENCNTR_ID ENCOUNTER_SK,
MAX(S_LH0.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM) AS MIN_BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH0
WHERE S_LH0.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND S_LH0.CURRENT_IND = 1
GROUP BY S_LH0.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
S_LH0.ENCNTR_ID
) INN
WHERE S_LH1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = INN.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
S_LH1.ENCNTR_ID = INN.ENCOUNTER_SK AND
S_LH1.ACTIVE_IND = 1 AND
--S_LH1.CURRENT_IND = 1 AND
S_LH1.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM = INN.MIN_BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
GROUP BY INN.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID,
INN.ENCOUNTER_SK
) OUTT
WHERE S_LH.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = OUTT.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
S_LH.ENCNTR_ID = OUTT.ENCOUNTER_SK AND
S_LH.ACTIVE_IND = 1 AND
--S_LH.CURRENT_IND = 1 AND
S_LH.ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID = OUTT.MIN_ENCNTR_LOC_ID
) LOC
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV1
ON CV1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = LOC.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
CV1.CODE_VALUE = LOC.ADMIT_LOCATION_SK AND
CV1.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND CV1.CURRENT_IND = 1

LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV2
ON CV2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = LOC.ENCOUNTER_HSS_ID AND
CV2.CODE_VALUE = LOC.ADMIT_UNIT_SK AND
CV2.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
--AND CV2.CURRENT_IND = 1
;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS aci.order_unit_temp; --20211021

-- START OPTIMIZED QUERY
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aci.order_unit_temp AS
WITH
orders_base AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cerner_ods.cerner_orders_hist
  WHERE
    ORIG_ORDER_DT_TM >= DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE("America/Chicago"), INTERVAL 24 MONTH), YEAR)
    AND TEMPLATE_ORDER_FLAG IN (0, 1, 5)
    AND ORIG_ORD_AS_FLAG IN (0, 1, 2)
),
actions_base AS (
  SELECT
    HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
    ORDER_ID,
    ACTION_DT_TM,
    UPDT_DT_TM
  FROM cerner_ods.cerner_order_action_hist
  WHERE ACTION_TYPE_CD = 2534
),
-- This CTE computes the ranking on a minimal set of columns to reduce shuffle
ranking_keys AS (
  SELECT
    S_O.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
    S_O.ORDER_ID,
    S_OA.ACTION_DT_TM,
    (CASE WHEN S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM > S_O.UPDT_DT_TM AND S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM IS NOT NULL THEN S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM ELSE S_O.UPDT_DT_TM END) AS ODS_PROCESS_DT_TM,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY S_O.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, S_O.ORDER_ID
      ORDER BY (CASE WHEN S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM > S_O.UPDT_DT_TM AND S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM IS NOT NULL THEN S_OA.UPDT_DT_TM ELSE S_O.UPDT_DT_TM END) DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS PICK_1
  FROM
    ( -- Select only columns needed for join and ranking from the pre-filtered orders
      SELECT HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDER_ID, UPDT_DT_TM FROM orders_base
    ) AS S_O
  LEFT JOIN
    actions_base AS S_OA
    ON S_O.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = S_OA.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND S_O.ORDER_ID = S_OA.ORDER_ID
),
final_keys AS (
  SELECT HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDER_ID, ACTION_DT_TM, ODS_PROCESS_DT_TM, PICK_1
  FROM ranking_keys
  WHERE PICK_1 = 1
)
-- Final SELECT joins the full data back to the filtered, ranked keys.
SELECT
  -- Reconstruct the exact output schema of the original query
  base.*,
  base.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AS ORDER_HSS_ID,
  base.ORDER_ID AS ORDER_SK,
  fk.ACTION_DT_TM,
  fk.ODS_PROCESS_DT_TM,
  fk.PICK_1
FROM
  orders_base AS base
INNER JOIN
  final_keys AS fk
  ON base.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = fk.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID AND base.ORDER_ID = fk.ORDER_ID;
-- END OPTIMIZED QUERY;


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS aci.cpoe_unit_order; --20211021

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aci.cpoe_unit_order AS
SELECT ORDER_HSS_ID,
ENCOUNTER_SK,
ORDER_SK,
CV1.DISPLAY ORDER_LOCATION ,
CV2.DISPLAY ORDER_UNIT
FROM ( SELECT OUTT.ORDER_HSS_ID,
OUTT.ENCOUNTER_SK,
OUTT.ORDER_SK,
S_LH.LOCATION_CD AS ORDER_LOCATION_SK,
S_LH.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD AS ORDER_UNIT_SK
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH,
( SELECT INN.ORDER_HSS_ID,
INN.ENCOUNTER_SK,
INN.ORDER_SK,
MAX(S_LH1.ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID) AS MAX_ENCNTR_LOC_ID
FROM cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH1,
( SELECT D_O4.ORDER_HSS_ID ORDER_HSS_ID,
D_O4.ENCNTR_ID ENCOUNTER_SK,
D_O4.ORDER_SK,
MAX(S_LH0.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM) AS MAX_BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM,
D_O4.ORIG_ORDER_DT_TM
FROM aci.order_unit_temp D_O4
JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist S_LH0
ON S_LH0.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = D_O4.ORDER_HSS_ID
AND S_LH0.ENCNTR_ID = D_O4.ENCNTR_ID
AND S_LH0.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM <= D_O4.ACTION_DT_TM
AND S_LH0.END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM > D_O4.ACTION_DT_TM
--AND S_LH0.CURRENT_IND = 1
GROUP BY D_O4.ORDER_HSS_ID, D_O4.ENCNTR_ID, D_O4.ORIG_ORDER_DT_TM, D_O4.ORDER_SK
) INN
WHERE S_LH1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = INN.ORDER_HSS_ID
AND S_LH1.ENCNTR_ID = INN.ENCOUNTER_SK
--AND S_LH1.CURRENT_IND = 1
AND S_LH1.BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM = INN.MAX_BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM
AND S_LH1.END_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM > INN.ORIG_ORDER_DT_TM
GROUP BY INN.ORDER_HSS_ID, INN.ENCOUNTER_SK, INN.ORDER_SK
) OUTT
WHERE S_LH.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = OUTT.ORDER_HSS_ID
AND S_LH.ENCNTR_ID = OUTT.ENCOUNTER_SK
--AND S_LH.CURRENT_IND = 1
AND S_LH.ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID = OUTT.MAX_ENCNTR_LOC_ID
) LOC
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV1
ON CV1.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = LOC.ORDER_HSS_ID
AND CV1.CODE_VALUE = LOC.ORDER_LOCATION_SK
AND CV1.ACTIVE_IND = 1
--AND CV1.CURRENT_IND = 1
LEFT JOIN cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist CV2
ON CV2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = LOC.ORDER_HSS_ID
AND CV2.CODE_VALUE = LOC.ORDER_UNIT_SK
AND CV2.ACTIVE_IND = 1
--AND CV2.CURRENT_IND = 1

      PHY_POS.ORDER_ID AS PHY_POS_ORDER_ID, PHY_POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN AS PHY_POS_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, PHY_POS.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS PHY_POS_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION,

      MAIN.CPOE_POSITION_IND AS MAIN_CPOE_POSITION_IND, MAIN.ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS MAIN_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, MAIN.ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION AS MAIN_ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION, MAIN.CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND AS MAIN_CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND, MAIN.PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION AS MAIN_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION
    FROM aci.cpoe_detail_cube_temp1 AS O

    LEFT JOIN aci.cpoe_orig_plan_positions AS PLAN_POS ON PLAN_POS.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND PLAN_POS.FACILITY_CD = O.FACILITY_CD
    LEFT JOIN aci.cpoe_orig_staff_positions AS STAFF_POS ON STAFF_POS.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND STAFF_POS.FACILITY_CD = O.FACILITY_CD

  Derived_And_Joined_Exceptions AS (

      UPPER(S.POS_ORDERING_PERSONNEL_POSITION) IN ('TEN_SUPPORT-CERNER', 'DBA') AS is_staff_pos_exception,

    LEFT JOIN CPOE_Position_List AS CPL_ORD_STAFF ON UPPER(CASE WHEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDERING_PERSON_POSITION WHEN UPPER(S.POS_ORDERING_PERSONNEL_POSITION) LIKE 'RO%' AND S.MAIN_CPOE_POSITION_IND = 1 THEN S.MAIN_ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION ELSE S.POS_ORDERING_PERSONNEL_POSITION END) = CPL_ORD_STAFF.excep_name

    LEFT JOIN Activity_Sub_Type_Exceptions AS ASTE ON UPPER(S.ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE) = ASTE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Activity_Type_Exceptions AS ATE ON UPPER(S.ACTIVITY_TYPE) = ATE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Communication_Type_Exceptions AS CTE ON UPPER(S.COMMUNICATION_TYPE) = CTE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Encounter_Type_Exceptions AS ETE ON UPPER(S.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP) = ETE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Medical_Service_Exceptions AS MSE ON UPPER(S.MEDICAL_SERVICE_DISP) = MSE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Order_Short_Desc_Exceptions AS OSDE ON UPPER(S.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) = OSDE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Ordering_Physician_Exceptions AS OPE ON UPPER(CASE WHEN S.PHY_POS_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN S.PHY_POS_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN ELSE S.POS_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN END) = OPE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Action_Personnel_Exceptions AS APE ON UPPER(CASE WHEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDERING_PERSON ELSE S.POS_ORDERING_PERSONNEL END) = APE.excep_name
  )
SELECT
  FACILITY_CD, MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR, FIN_NBR AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, ORDER_ID, PERSON_FULL_NAME AS PATIENT_FULL_NM, ADMIT_UNIT AS NURSING_UNIT, ORDER_UNIT AS LOCATION_DESC, ORDER_ACTION_TS,
  CASE WHEN ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP IN ('1 - Inpatient', 'Inpatient') THEN 'Inpatients - I' WHEN ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP IN ('2 - Outpatient', 'Outpatient') THEN 'Outpatients - O' WHEN ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP = '0 - Preadmit' THEN 'Pre-Admits - P' WHEN ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP = '9 - Non Patient' THEN 'Non-Patients - N' ELSE ENCOUNTER_TYPE_DISP END AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE,
  ACTIVITY_TYPE, ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN, ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORIG_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORDERING_PERSONNEL, ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION, ORIG_ORDERING_PERSONNEL_POSITION, COMMUNICATION_TYPE, UPPER(CLINICAL_CATEGORY) AS ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_CATALOG_DESC, ORDER_NM, CLINICAL_DISPLAY_LINE AS ORDER_DESC, POWER_PLAN_DESC AS POWER_PLAN, POWER_PHASE_DESC AS POWER_PHASE, CUSTOM_PLAN_DESC AS CUSTOM_PLAN, POWER_PLAN_DATE_TIME AS ORDER_PLANNING_TS, POWER_PLAN_ID, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN, PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, ORIG_PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION, PHYSICIAN_NPI AS NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID_NBR, PHYSICIAN_GROUP_SPECIALTY AS PHYSICIAN_SPECIALTY_DESC, UPPER(ORDER_CLINICAL_CATEGORY) AS ORDER_CLINICAL_CATEGORY, MEDICAL_SERVICE_DISP AS HOSP_SERVICE_DESC, ADMIT_DATE AS ADMISSION_DT, DISCHARGE_DATE AS DISCHARGE_DT, STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS, PLANNING_DATE_TIME, ORDER_SOURCE,
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(COMMUNICATION_TYPE) IN ('INITIAL PLAN', 'PROVIDER PLANNEN PLAN', 'INITIATE POWERPLAN PLANNED BY PROVIDER')
    AND ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION NOT IN ('RadNet: Film Librarian CPOE', 'RadNet: Mammo Tech CPOE', 'RadNet: Rad Tech CPOE', 'RadNet: RadTech/Transcription CPOE', 'RadNet: Supervisor CPOE', 'RadNet: Transcription CPOE')
    AND is_not_in_cpoe_pos_list_orig_plan
    THEN CASE
      WHEN PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION IS NOT NULL AND (ORDER_SOURCE = 'FP' OR ORDER_SOURCE = 'PP') THEN 'Plan not Last Planned by a Provider - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
      WHEN PLANNING_PHYSICIAN_POSITION IS NULL AND (ORDER_SOURCE = 'FP' OR ORDER_SOURCE = 'PP') THEN 'Plan not planned by a Provider - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
      WHEN ORDER_SOURCE = 'CS' THEN 'Care Set Order - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
      WHEN ORDER_SOURCE = 'SO' THEN 'Single Order - Provider Planned Plan comm type not appropriate'
    END
  END AS REASON_ON_REPORT,
  CASE
    WHEN is_phys_pos_exception THEN 'PHYSICIAN POSITION'
    WHEN is_staff_pos_exception THEN 'STAFF POSITION'
    WHEN is_act_sub_type_exception THEN 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE'
    WHEN is_act_type_exception THEN 'ACTIVITY TYPE'

    WHEN is_enc_type_exception THEN 'ENCOUNTER TYPE'
