    WHEN ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL THEN 'NO ORDERING PHYSICIAN'
    WHEN BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1 THEN 'BILL ONLY'
    WHEN ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270 THEN 'PHARMACY ORDER'
    WHEN UPPER(ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%' THEN 'SYSTEM PHYSICIAN'
    WHEN is_action_pers_exception THEN 'ORDERING PERSONNEL'
    ELSE 'NOT EXCEPTION'
  END AS EXCEPTION_REASON,
  CASE WHEN UPPER(ORDER_NM) = 'ALERT!' AND UPPER(ORDER_TYPE) IN ('CONTINUOUS INFUSIONS', 'IV INFUSIONS', 'IV SOLUTIONS', 'MEDICATIONS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS MED_FLAG,
  NEWBORN_FLAG, NICU_DAYS, CPOE_POSITION_IND, CPOE_COMMUNICATION_IND, CPOE_PWR_PLAN_POSITION_IND,
  CASE WHEN CASE WHEN is_phys_pos_exception THEN 'PHYSICIAN POSITION' WHEN is_staff_pos_exception THEN 'STAFF POSITION' WHEN is_act_sub_type_exception THEN 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE' WHEN is_act_type_exception THEN 'ACTIVITY TYPE' WHEN is_comm_type_exception THEN 'COMMUNICATION TYPE' WHEN is_enc_type_exception THEN 'ENCOUNTER TYPE' WHEN is_med_svc_exception THEN 'MEDICAL SERVICE' WHEN is_ord_short_desc_exception THEN 'ORDERABLE' WHEN is_ord_phys_exception THEN 'ORDERING PHYSICIAN' WHEN ORDERING_PHYSICIAN IS NULL THEN 'NO ORDERING PHYSICIAN' WHEN BILL_ONLY_FLG = 1 THEN 'BILL ONLY' WHEN ORDER_APPLICATION_NBR = 560270 THEN 'PHARMACY ORDER' WHEN UPPER(ORDERING_PHYSICIAN) LIKE 'SYSTEM%' THEN 'SYSTEM PHYSICIAN' WHEN is_action_pers_exception THEN 'ORDERING PERSONNEL' ELSE 'NOT EXCEPTION' END = 'NOT EXCEPTION' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CPOE_EXCEPTION_IND,
  CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago") AS CREATE_TS, 'CPOE_STG' AS CREATE_UID
FROM Derived_And_Joined_Exceptions;

-- =================================================================================================
-- 4. Validation Step: Compare the two tables and check optimized duplicates.
-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View discrepancy rows.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES;

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

  Derived_And_Joined_Exceptions AS (

    LEFT JOIN CPOE_Position_List AS CPL_ORD_STAFF ON UPPER(CASE WHEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDERING_PERSON_POSITION WHEN UPPER(S.POS_ORDERING_PERSONNEL_POSITION) LIKE 'RO%' AND S.MAIN_CPOE_POSITION_IND = 1 THEN S.MAIN_ORDERING_STAFF_POSITION ELSE S.POS_ORDERING_PERSONNEL_POSITION END) = CPL_ORD_STAFF.excep_name

    LEFT JOIN Order_Short_Desc_Exceptions AS OSDE ON UPPER(S.ORDER_CATALOG_DESC) = OSDE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Ordering_Physician_Exceptions AS OPE ON UPPER(CASE WHEN S.PHY_POS_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN S.PHY_POS_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN ELSE S.POS_ORDERING_PHYSICIAN END) = OPE.excep_name
    LEFT JOIN Action_Personnel_Exceptions AS APE ON UPPER(CASE WHEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN S.STAFF_POS_ORDERING_PERSON ELSE S.POS_ORDERING_PERSONNEL END) = APE.excep_name

    END

  CASE
    WHEN is_phys_pos_exception THEN 'PHYSICIAN POSITION'
    WHEN is_staff_pos_exception THEN 'STAFF POSITION'
    WHEN is_act_sub_type_exception THEN 'ACTIVITY SUB TYPE'

CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_clinical_event_chg_baths AS
WITH
  -- Consolidate the logic for identifying INSERTION and REMOVAL event codes
  -- into a single CTE. This avoids scanning cerner_code_value_hist multiple times.
  code_value_map AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      code_value,
      'INSERTION' AS CL_TYPE,
      display_key,
      display
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist
    WHERE
      code_set = 72
      AND (
        display_key IN ('URINARYCATHETERPRESENTONARRIVALDG')
        OR display IN (
          'Urinary Catheter Insertion Date DG',
          'Urinary Catheter Present on Arrival:',
          'Urinary Catheter Insertion/POA Date DG'
        )
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      code_value,
      'REMOVAL' AS CL_TYPE,
      display_key,
      display
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist
    WHERE
      code_set = 72
      AND display IN (
        'Urinary Catheter Removal Date DG',
        'Urinary Catheter Discontinue Date/Time'
      )
  ),
  -- Filter the large clinical_event table once.
  clinical_events AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      encntr_id,
      ce_dynamic_label_id,
      event_cd,
      result_status_cd,
      event_end_dt_tm,
      event_id
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_clinical_event_hist
    WHERE
      valid_until_dt_tm >= CURRENT_DATE()
  ),
  -- Filter the large date_result table once.
  date_results AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      event_id,
      result_dt_tm
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_ce_date_result_hist
    WHERE
      valid_until_dt_tm >= CURRENT_DATETIME()
  ),
  -- Pre-filter status codes to avoid a repetitive join.
  valid_status_codes AS (
    SELECT
      code_value,
      health_system_source_id
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist
    WHERE
      code_set = 8
      AND cdf_meaning <> 'INERROR'
  ),
  -- Combine all logic before the final window function.
  final_events AS (
    SELECT
      cvm.CL_TYPE,
      ce.health_system_source_id,
      ce.encntr_id,
      ce.ce_dynamic_label_id,
      ce.event_cd,
      ce.result_status_cd,
      cvm.display_key,
      cvm.display,
      cdr.result_dt_tm,
      ce.event_end_dt_tm
    FROM clinical_events AS ce
    INNER JOIN code_value_map AS cvm
      ON ce.health_system_source_id = cvm.health_system_source_id
      AND ce.event_cd = cvm.code_value
    INNER JOIN valid_status_codes AS vsc
      ON ce.health_system_source_id = vsc.health_system_source_id
      AND ce.result_status_cd = vsc.code_value
    LEFT JOIN date_results AS cdr
      ON ce.health_system_source_id = cdr.health_system_source_id
      AND ce.event_id = cdr.event_id
  )
SELECT
  fe.CL_TYPE,
  fe.health_system_source_id,
  fe.encntr_id,
  fe.ce_dynamic_label_id,
  fe.event_cd,
  fe.result_status_cd,
  fe.display_key,
  fe.display,
  fe.result_dt_tm,
  fe.event_end_dt_tm,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY fe.health_system_source_id, fe.encntr_id, fe.ce_dynamic_label_id
    ORDER BY
      fe.health_system_source_id, fe.encntr_id, fe.event_end_dt_tm
  ) AS pick_1
FROM final_events AS fe;
-- END OPTIMIZED QUERY ;

 --DROP TABLE TEMP_CLINICAL_EVENT_CHG_BATHS_NUMERATOR IF EXISTS;
CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_clinical_event_chg_baths_numerator AS
WITH
  -- Filtered encounters, selecting only necessary columns to reduce data shuffle.
  encounters AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      encntr_id,
      facility_cd
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata.clinical_ops.cno_hai_daily_encounter_data`
    WHERE
      health_system_source_id <> 80040
  ),
  -- Relevant CHG bath event codes.
  chg_bath_codes AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      code_value,
      display,
      display_key
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist`
    WHERE
      code_set = 72
      AND display_key IN (
        'CHLORHEXIDINEGLUCONATEBATH',
        'HYGIENECHGBATH',
        'CHLORHEXIDINEGLUCONATEBATHINDICATIONS'
      )
  ),
  -- Status codes that indicate an error. Using GROUP BY is equivalent to DISTINCT.
  in_error_codes AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      code_value
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist`
    WHERE
      cdf_meaning = 'INERROR'
      AND code_set = 8
    GROUP BY
      1,
      2
  ),
  -- Facility timezone mapping.
  facility_timezones AS (
    SELECT
      facility_cd,
      timezone_bq
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata.clinical_ops.cerner_facility_timezone`
  )
SELECT
  cer.health_system_source_id,
  cer.encntr_id,
  cer.ce_dynamic_label_id,
  CASE
    WHEN tz.timezone_bq IS NOT NULL THEN DATE(TIMESTAMP(cer.event_end_dt_tm), tz.timezone_bq)
    ELSE DATE(cer.event_end_dt_tm)
  END AS event_end_dt,
  cv.display,
  cv.display_key,
  CASE
    WHEN UPPER(TRIM(cer.result_val)) LIKE '%CONTRAINDICATED%' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS contraind_ind
FROM
  `thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_clinical_event_hist` AS cer
  INNER JOIN encounters AS e ON cer.health_system_source_id = e.health_system_source_id
  AND cer.encntr_id = e.encntr_id
  INNER JOIN chg_bath_codes AS cv ON cer.health_system_source_id = cv.health_system_source_id
  AND cer.event_cd = cv.code_value
  LEFT JOIN facility_timezones AS tz ON e.facility_cd = tz.facility_cd
WHERE
  cer.valid_until_dt_tm >= CURRENT_DATETIME()
  AND UPPER(cer.event_tag) NOT LIKE 'DATE%TIME CORRECTION'
  AND cer.result_val <> 'Refused'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      in_error_codes AS iec
    WHERE
      cer.health_system_source_id = iec.health_system_source_id
      AND cer.result_status_cd = iec.code_value
  )
;

    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_ce_date_result_hist
    WHERE

  ),
  code_value_status AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      code_value
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist
    WHERE
      code_set = 8 AND cdf_meaning <> 'INERROR'
  ),
  code_value_insertion AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      code_value,
      display_key,
      display
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist
    WHERE
      code_set = 72
      AND (
        display_key = 'URINARYCATHETERPRESENTONARRIVAL'
        OR display IN ('Urinary Catheter Insertion Date', 'Urinary Catheter Insertion Date/Time')
      )
  ),
  code_value_removal AS (
    SELECT
      health_system_source_id,
      code_value,
      display_key,
      display
    FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist
    WHERE
      code_set = 72
      AND display IN (
        'Urinary Catheter Removal Date',
        'Urinary Catheter Removal Date/Time',
        'Urinary Catheter Discontinue Date/Time'
      )
  ),
  insertions AS (
    SELECT
      'INSERTION' AS cl_type,
      ce.health_system_source_id,
      ce.encntr_id,
      ce.ce_dynamic_label_id,
      ce.event_cd,
      ce.result_status_cd,
      cv1.display_key,
      cv1.display,
      CASE
        WHEN cv1.display_key = 'URINARYCATHETERPRESENTONARRIVAL'
        THEN ce.event_end_dt_tm
        ELSE cdr.result_dt_tm
      END AS pre_cerner_dt,
      cdr.result_dt_tm,
      ce.event_end_dt_tm,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          ce.health_system_source_id,
          ce.encntr_id,
          ce.ce_dynamic_label_id
        ORDER BY
          ce.health_system_source_id,
          ce.encntr_id,
          cdr.result_dt_tm
      ) AS pick_1
    FROM clinical_events_filtered AS ce
    INNER JOIN code_value_insertion AS cv1
      ON ce.health_system_source_id = cv1.health_system_source_id AND ce.event_cd = cv1.code_value
    INNER JOIN code_value_status AS cv2
      ON ce.health_system_source_id = cv2.health_system_source_id AND ce.result_status_cd = cv2.code_value
    LEFT JOIN ce_date_results_filtered AS cdr
      ON cdr.health_system_source_id = ce.health_system_source_id AND cdr.event_id = ce.event_id
  ),
  removals AS (
    SELECT
      'REMOVAL' AS cl_type,
      ce.health_system_source_id,
      ce.encntr_id,
      ce.ce_dynamic_label_id,
      ce.event_cd,
      ce.result_status_cd,
      cv1.display_key,
      cv1.display,
      cdr.result_dt_tm AS pre_cerner_dt,
      cdr.result_dt_tm,
      ce.event_end_dt_tm,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY
          ce.health_system_source_id,
          ce.encntr_id,
          ce.ce_dynamic_label_id,
          ce.event_cd
        ORDER BY
          ce.health_system_source_id,
          ce.encntr_id,
          cdr.result_dt_tm
      ) AS pick_1
    FROM clinical_events_filtered AS ce
    INNER JOIN code_value_removal AS cv1
      ON ce.health_system_source_id = cv1.health_system_source_id AND ce.event_cd = cv1.code_value
    INNER JOIN code_value_status AS cv2
      ON ce.health_system_source_id = cv2.health_system_source_id AND ce.result_status_cd = cv2.code_value
    LEFT JOIN ce_date_results_filtered AS cdr
      ON cdr.health_system_source_id = ce.health_system_source_id AND cdr.event_id = ce.event_id
  )
SELECT
  cl_type,
  health_system_source_id,
  encntr_id,
  ce_dynamic_label_id,
  event_cd,
  result_status_cd,
  display_key,
  display,
  pre_cerner_dt,
  result_dt_tm,
  event_end_dt_tm,
  pick_1
FROM insertions

  result_status_cd,
  display_key,
  display,

  pick_1

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE idm.CERNER_ORDERS_PRIORITY
CLUSTER BY HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID, ORDER_ID AS (
  WITH
    filtered_orders AS (
      -- Filter the main source table once. This corresponds to the original S04 stage.
      SELECT
        HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
        ORDER_ID,
        OE_FIELD_MEANING,
        OE_FIELD_VALUE
      FROM
        cerner_ods.cerner_order_detail_hist
      WHERE
        OE_FIELD_MEANING IN ('COLLPRI', 'REPPRI', 'PRIORITY', 'RXPRIORITY')
    )
  SELECT
    orders.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,
    orders.ORDER_ID,
    base.facility_cd,
    -- Pivot data using conditional aggregation. This replaces three LEFT JOINs with one.
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN UPPER(orders.OE_FIELD_MEANING) = 'COLLPRI'
        THEN cv.DISPLAY
      END
    ) AS COLLECTION_PRIORITY,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN UPPER(orders.OE_FIELD_MEANING) = 'REPPRI'
        THEN cv.DISPLAY
      END
    ) AS REPORT_PRIORITY,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN UPPER(orders.OE_FIELD_MEANING) IN ('PRIORITY', 'RXPRIORITY')
        THEN cv.DISPLAY
      END
    ) AS ORDER_PRIORITY_NM
  FROM
    filtered_orders AS orders
  INNER JOIN
    idm.CERNER_BASE AS base
    ON base.health_system_source_id = orders.health_system_source_id
    AND base.order_id = orders.order_id
  LEFT JOIN

    ON orders.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = cv.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
    AND orders.OE_FIELD_VALUE = cv.CODE_VALUE
  GROUP BY
    1, 2, 3
);

      TRIM(FE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) AS VG6ACCTNO,

-- CTE: Combine DAAC and NM visit data
CREATE TEMP TABLE SRC_STAGING_VISIT AS (
SELECT
V.V7HOSP AS HOSP_CD, CAST(V.V7PAT AS STRING) AS PATNO, Trim(V.V7PATT) AS V7PATT, V.V7ADMD, V.V7DISD, PT.PATIENT_CLASS_CD,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ') AS patient_class_type, Trim(V.V7DSCASEF) AS V7DSCASEF, V.V7LOFS, V.V7NICU, O.OBSDSQTY,
     V.V7HOSP_THC_SRC, V.V7LCHD,  'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM, regexp_replace(TRIM(CAST(V.V79SRVG AS STRING)), r'[^0-9a-zA-Z/]', '') AS V7SRVG
FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_visit_hist AS V
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO, 'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM, SUM(OBSDSQTY) AS OBSDSQTY FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_obshdfile_hist GROUP BY OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO, SOURCE_SYSTEM) AS O ON V.V7HOSP = O.OBSDHOSP AND V.V7PAT = O.OBSDPATNO
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT daac_pattype_hk AS DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK,TRIM(Q8PTYP) AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD,TRIM(Q8PTPD) AS ENCOUNTER_CD_DESC,CASE WHEN TRIM(UPPER(Q8HOSP)) = 'TRA' AND TRIM(Q8PTCL) = 'E' THEN 'O' ELSE TRIM(Q8PTCL) END AS PATIENT_CLASS_CD, Q8HOSP  FROM `thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_pattype_hist` ) AS PT ON LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ')) = LOWER(TRIM(PT.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD)) AND TRIM(UPPER(V.V7HOSP)) = TRIM(UPPER(PT.Q8HOSP))
WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(V7LCHD AS STRING)) >= V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT AND
    (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp_thc_src)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
OR (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND v7hosp_thc_src IS NULL)) --AND (V.V7ADMD <> 99999999 OR V.V7DISD <> 99999999)

UNION ALL

SELECT
V.V7HOSP AS HOSP_CD, TRIM(V.V7PAT) AS PATNO, Trim(V.V7PATT) AS V7PATT, V.V7ADMD, V.V7DISD,PT.PATIENT_CLASS_CD,
      REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ') AS patient_class_type, Trim(V.V7DSCASEF) AS V7DSCASEF , V.V7LOFS, V.V7NICU, O.OBSDSQTY,
      V.V7HOSP_THC_SRC, V.V7LCHD, V.SOURCE_SYSTEM, regexp_replace(TRIM(V.V7SRVG), r'[^0-9a-zA-Z/]', '') AS V7SRVG
FROM thcdnaproddata.staging.nm_visit AS V
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO, SUM(OBSDSQTY) AS OBSDSQTY FROM thcdnaproddata.staging.nm_obshdfile GROUP BY OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO) AS O ON V.V7HOSP = O.OBSDHOSP AND V.V7PAT = O.OBSDPATNO
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT nm_pattype_hk AS DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK,TRIM(Q8PTYP) AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD,TRIM(Q8PTPD) AS ENCOUNTER_CD_DESC,CASE WHEN TRIM(UPPER(Q8HOSP)) = 'TRA' AND TRIM(Q8PTCL) = 'E' THEN 'O' ELSE TRIM(Q8PTCL) END AS PATIENT_CLASS_CD, Q8HOSP FROM staging.nm_pattype ) PT ON LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ')) = LOWER(TRIM(PT.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD)) AND TRIM(UPPER(V.V7HOSP)) = TRIM(UPPER(PT.Q8HOSP))
WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(V7LCHD AS STRING)) >= V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT AND
    (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp_thc_src)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
OR (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND v7hosp_thc_src IS NULL)) AND V.V7PAT IS NOT NULL AND ((V.V7ADMD >= 20130101 AND V.V7ADMD <> 99999999 )
    OR (V.V7DISD >= 20130101 AND V.V7DISD <> 99999999) OR (V.V7DISD IS NULL AND V.V7ADMD IS NULL))
);

-- CTE: Prepare the data for the final insert format
CREATE TEMP TABLE PREP_FINAL_INSERT AS (
SELECT --t11.DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK,
CAST(CASE WHEN t6.V7DSCASEF = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT64) AS DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,
CASE WHEN t6.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND t6.V7DSCASEF = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IP_ENCOUNTERS,
CAST(CASE WHEN t6.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND t6.V7DSCASEF = 'Y' THEN CAST(t6.V7LOFS AS INT64) ELSE 0 END AS NUMERIC) AS IP_DAYS, CAST(t6.V7NICU AS NUMERIC) AS NICU_DAYS,

    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN t6.V7ADMD IS NOT NULL
         AND t6.V7ADMD NOT IN (0, 99999999)
         AND LENGTH(CAST(t6.V7ADMD AS STRING)) = 8
        THEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7ADMD AS STRING))
        ELSE PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '0001-01-01')
      END
    AS STRING)
  ) = 1
  THEN
    CASE
      WHEN t6.V7ADMD IS NOT NULL
       AND t6.V7ADMD NOT IN (0, 99999999)
       AND LENGTH(CAST(t6.V7ADMD AS STRING)) = 8
      THEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7ADMD AS STRING))
      ELSE PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '0001-01-01')
    END
  ELSE NULL
END AS ADMISSION_DT,
CASE
  WHEN `thcdnaproddata`.staging.ds_isvaliddate(
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN t6.V7DISD IS NOT NULL
         AND t6.V7DISD NOT IN (0, 99999999)
         AND LENGTH(CAST(t6.V7DISD AS STRING)) = 8
        THEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7DISD AS STRING))
        ELSE PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '0001-01-01')
      END
    AS STRING)
  ) = 1
  THEN
    CASE

       AND t6.V7DISD NOT IN (0, 99999999)
       AND LENGTH(CAST(t6.V7DISD AS STRING)) = 8
      THEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7DISD AS STRING))
      ELSE PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '0001-01-01')
    END
  ELSE NULL
END AS DISCHARGE_DT,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7LCHD AS STRING)) AS LAST_CHANGE_DATE, t6.SOURCE_SYSTEM,  CAST(t6.V7LOFS AS NUMERIC) AS LENGTH_OF_STAY, t6.std_rev_grp_code
    FROM XFM_KEYS AS t6
    --LEFT JOIN DIM_STD_REV_GRP t11 ON LOWER(t6.std_rev_grp_code) = LOWER(t11.SRG9_CD)

 --I) Decision Support Case Flag (charges + patient class)
-- START OPTIMIZED QUERY
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_decision_support AS
WITH max_post_date AS (
  -- Isolate the max date calculation to run once, improving clarity and stability.
  SELECT
    MAX(f.POSTING_DT) AS max_dt
  FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges AS f
  WHERE
    -- Simplified the original redundant filter: (A) OR (A AND B) is equivalent to A.
    LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
),
charges_union AS (
  SELECT
    TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD,
    CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    TRIM(n.V2REVC) AS REVENUE_CD,
    CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC) AS QTY
  FROM `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges AS n
  CROSS JOIN max_post_date -- Makes the single max_dt value available efficiently.
  WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
    -- This predicate is now SARGable, allowing for range scans on v2pstd if it is clustered/sorted.
    AND CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING) > FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', max_post_date.max_dt)
    AND (
      (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    )

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    f.FACILITY_CD,
    f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    f.REVENUE_CD,
    f.CHARGE_QUANTITY AS QTY
  FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges AS f
  WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
    -- Simplified the original redundant filter.
    AND LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
),
dsc_calc AS (
  SELECT
    FACILITY_CD,
    PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '110' AND '179') OR (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '190' AND '219') THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS qty_incl,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '170' AND '179') AND REVENUE_CD NOT IN ('172','173','174','0172','0173','0174') THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS qty_excl
  FROM charges_union
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  f.FACILITY_CD,
  f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
  CAST(
    CASE
      WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' THEN
        CASE WHEN IFNULL(dc.qty_incl, 0) > IFNULL(dc.qty_excl, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS INT64
  ) AS DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG
FROM fact_encounter_temp AS f
LEFT JOIN dsc_calc AS dc
  ON dc.FACILITY_CD = f.FACILITY_CD AND dc.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
WHERE f.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC', 'EMC_MEDITECH', 'HIDES_MEDITECH');
-- END OPTIMIZED QUERY;


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG = S.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'DSC_FLAG'
  FROM tmp_decision_support S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );



  --K) IP metrics (uses patient class + DSC)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_ip_metrics AS
  SELECT
    f.FACILITY_CD, f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    CASE WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND COALESCE(ds.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IP_ENCOUNTERS,
    CASE WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND COALESCE(ds.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,0) = 1 THEN f.LENGTH_OF_STAY ELSE 0 END AS IP_DAYS
  FROM fact_encounter_temp f
  LEFT JOIN tmp_decision_support ds
    ON ds.FACILITY_CD = f.FACILITY_CD AND ds.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  WHERE f.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.IP_ENCOUNTERS = S.IP_ENCOUNTERS,
      T.IP_DAYS       = S.IP_DAYS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'IP_METRICS'
  FROM tmp_ip_metrics S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );


  --L) NICU_DAYS (non-DAAC sources)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_nicu_days AS
  SELECT
    TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD,
    CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SUM(CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC)) AS NICU_DAYS
  FROM `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges n
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic' AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > (select max(POSTING_DT) from `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f WHERE ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))) OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)))
    AND ((LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
         OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL))
    AND TRIM(n.V2REVC) IN ('172','173','174','0172','0173','0174')
  GROUP BY 1,2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, SUM(CHARGE_QUANTITY) AS NICU_DAYS
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
         AND ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL))
           AND f.REVENUE_CD IN ('172','173','174','0172','0173','0174')
  GROUP BY 1,2;


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.NICU_DAYS = S.NICU_DAYS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'NICU_DAYS'
  FROM tmp_nicu_days S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );

  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp F
  SET F.OBSERVATION_HOURS = 0
  WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM IN('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');

  --H) Observation Hours (charges base)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_observation_hours AS
  WITH obh_epic AS (
    SELECT
      TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD,
      CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      SUM(CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC)) AS QTY
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges n
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic' AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > (select max(POSTING_DT) from `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f WHERE ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))) OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)))
      AND ((LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL))
      AND TRIM(n.V2CHG) IN ('762000001','762000002')
    GROUP BY 1,2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
    FACILITY_CD,
    PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SUM(CHARGE_QUANTITY) AS QTY
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
         AND ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL))
      AND CHARGE_NBR  IN ('762000001' ,'762000002')
    GROUP BY 1,2
  )
  SELECT
    F.FACILITY_CD, F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    CASE
      WHEN F.SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'BAPTIST_EPIC' THEN IFNULL(e.QTY,0)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS OBSERVATION_HOURS
  FROM fact_encounter_temp F
  LEFT JOIN obh_epic e
    ON e.FACILITY_CD = F.FACILITY_CD AND e.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  WHERE F.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.OBSERVATION_HOURS = S.OBSERVATION_HOURS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'OBS_HOURS'
  FROM tmp_observation_hours S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );



SET DML_1 = CONCAT(
  """
MERGE `thcdnaproddata.idm.pre_fact_encounter_charges` AS T
USING fact_encounter_temp AS S
ON T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND T.FACILITY_CD = S.FACILITY_CD
WHEN MATCHED THEN
  UPDATE SET
    T.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG = S.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,
    T.IP_ENCOUNTERS = S.IP_ENCOUNTERS,
    T.IP_DAYS = S.IP_DAYS,
    T.NICU_DAYS = S.NICU_DAYS,
    T.OBSERVATION_HOURS = S.OBSERVATION_HOURS,
    T.LAST_CHANGE_DATE = S.LAST_CHANGE_DATE,
    T.LENGTH_OF_STAY = S.LENGTH_OF_STAY,
    T.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = S.PATIENT_CLASS_CD,
    T.DISCHARGE_DT = S.DISCHARGE_DT,
    T.SOURCE_SYSTEM = S.SOURCE_SYSTEM

 --I) Decision Support Case Flag (charges + patient class)
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_decision_support AS
  WITH charges_union AS (
    SELECT TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD, CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
           TRIM(n.V2REVC) AS REVENUE_CD, CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC) AS QTY
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges n
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic' AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > (select max(POSTING_DT) from `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f WHERE ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))) OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)))
      AND ((LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
    FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, REVENUE_CD, CHARGE_QUANTITY AS QTY
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
         AND ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL))
  ),
  dsc_calc AS (
    SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '110' AND '179') OR (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '190' AND '219') THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS qty_incl,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '170' AND '179') AND REVENUE_CD NOT IN ('172','173','174','0172','0173','0174')
               THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS qty_excl
    FROM charges_union
    GROUP BY 1,2
  )
  SELECT
    f.FACILITY_CD, f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' THEN
          CASE WHEN IFNULL(dc.qty_incl,0) > IFNULL(dc.qty_excl,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 1
      END AS INT64
    ) AS DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG
  FROM fact_encounter_temp f
  LEFT JOIN dsc_calc dc
    ON dc.FACILITY_CD = f.FACILITY_CD AND dc.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  WHERE f.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T

  FROM tmp_decision_support S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)

    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );



  --K) IP metrics (uses patient class + DSC)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_ip_metrics AS
  SELECT
    f.FACILITY_CD, f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    CASE WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND COALESCE(ds.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IP_ENCOUNTERS,
    CASE WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND COALESCE(ds.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,0) = 1 THEN f.LENGTH_OF_STAY ELSE 0 END AS IP_DAYS
  FROM fact_encounter_temp f
  LEFT JOIN tmp_decision_support ds
    ON ds.FACILITY_CD = f.FACILITY_CD AND ds.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  WHERE f.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.IP_ENCOUNTERS = S.IP_ENCOUNTERS,
      T.IP_DAYS       = S.IP_DAYS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'IP_METRICS'
  FROM tmp_ip_metrics S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );


  --L) NICU_DAYS (non-DAAC sources)
  -- START OPTIMIZED QUERY
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_nicu_days AS
WITH
  target_facility AS (
    -- Define the target facility once to avoid repeated function calls.
    SELECT LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AS facility_id
  ),
  fact_charges_filtered AS (
    -- Scan fact_charges only ONCE, applying common filters.
    SELECT
      f.FACILITY_CD,
      f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      f.CHARGE_QUANTITY,
      f.REVENUE_CD,
      f.POSTING_DT
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_charges` AS f
      CROSS JOIN target_facility
    WHERE
      LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
      -- The original predicate was (A) OR (A AND B), which is logically equivalent to A.
      AND LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = target_facility.facility_id
  ),
  max_posting_date AS (
    -- Calculate the max posting date from the single, filtered scan.
    SELECT MAX(POSTING_DT) AS max_dt FROM fact_charges_filtered
  ),
  nm_charges_agg AS (
    -- Process the first branch (staging data) using the pre-calculated max_dt.
    SELECT
      TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD,
      CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      SUM(CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC)) AS NICU_DAYS
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges AS n,
      max_posting_date,
      target_facility
    WHERE
      LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
      AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > max_posting_date.max_dt
      AND (
        (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = target_facility.facility_id)
        OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = target_facility.facility_id AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL)
      )
      AND TRIM(n.V2REVC) IN ('172', '173', '174', '0172', '0173', '0174')
    GROUP BY
      1, 2
  ),
  fact_charges_agg AS (
    -- Process the second branch (historical data) from the same single scan.
    SELECT
      FACILITY_CD,
      PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      SUM(CHARGE_QUANTITY) AS NICU_DAYS
    FROM
      fact_charges_filtered
    WHERE
      REVENUE_CD IN ('172', '173', '174', '0172', '0173', '0174')
    GROUP BY
      1, 2
  )
-- Combine the results, same as the original query.
SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, NICU_DAYS FROM nm_charges_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, NICU_DAYS FROM fact_charges_agg;
-- END OPTIMIZED QUERY;


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.NICU_DAYS = S.NICU_DAYS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'NICU_DAYS'
  FROM tmp_nicu_days S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)

  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp F
  SET F.OBSERVATION_HOURS = 0
  WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM IN('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');

  --H) Observation Hours (charges base)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_observation_hours AS
  WITH obh_epic AS (
    SELECT

    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic' AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > (select max(POSTING_DT) from `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f WHERE ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))) OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)))
      AND ((LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL))
      AND TRIM(n.V2CHG) IN ('762000001','762000002')
    GROUP BY 1,2
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
    FACILITY_CD,
    PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SUM(CHARGE_QUANTITY) AS QTY
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
         AND ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL))
      AND CHARGE_NBR  IN ('762000001' ,'762000002')
    GROUP BY 1,2
  )
  SELECT
    F.FACILITY_CD, F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    CASE
      WHEN F.SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'BAPTIST_EPIC' THEN IFNULL(e.QTY,0)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS OBSERVATION_HOURS
  FROM fact_encounter_temp F
  LEFT JOIN obh_epic e
    ON e.FACILITY_CD = F.FACILITY_CD AND e.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  WHERE F.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.OBSERVATION_HOURS = S.OBSERVATION_HOURS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'OBS_HOURS'
  FROM tmp_observation_hours S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))

-- CTE: Combine DAAC and NM visit data
CREATE TEMP TABLE SRC_STAGING_VISIT AS (
SELECT

     V.V7HOSP_THC_SRC, V.V7LCHD,  'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM, regexp_replace(TRIM(CAST(V.V79SRVG AS STRING)), r'[^0-9a-zA-Z/]', '') AS V7SRVG
FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_visit_hist AS V
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO, 'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM, SUM(OBSDSQTY) AS OBSDSQTY FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_obshdfile_hist GROUP BY OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO, SOURCE_SYSTEM) AS O ON V.V7HOSP = O.OBSDHOSP AND V.V7PAT = O.OBSDPATNO
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT daac_pattype_hk AS DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK,TRIM(Q8PTYP) AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD,TRIM(Q8PTPD) AS ENCOUNTER_CD_DESC,CASE WHEN TRIM(UPPER(Q8HOSP)) = 'TRA' AND TRIM(Q8PTCL) = 'E' THEN 'O' ELSE TRIM(Q8PTCL) END AS PATIENT_CLASS_CD, Q8HOSP  FROM `thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_pattype_hist` ) AS PT ON LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ')) = LOWER(TRIM(PT.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD)) AND TRIM(UPPER(V.V7HOSP)) = TRIM(UPPER(PT.Q8HOSP))
WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(V7LCHD AS STRING)) >= V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT AND
    (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp_thc_src)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
OR (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND v7hosp_thc_src IS NULL)) --AND (V.V7ADMD <> 99999999 OR V.V7DISD <> 99999999)

UNION ALL

SELECT
V.V7HOSP AS HOSP_CD, TRIM(V.V7PAT) AS PATNO, Trim(V.V7PATT) AS V7PATT, V.V7ADMD, V.V7DISD,PT.PATIENT_CLASS_CD,
      REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ') AS patient_class_type, Trim(V.V7DSCASEF) AS V7DSCASEF , V.V7LOFS, V.V7NICU, O.OBSDSQTY,
      V.V7HOSP_THC_SRC, V.V7LCHD, V.SOURCE_SYSTEM, regexp_replace(TRIM(V.V7SRVG), r'[^0-9a-zA-Z/]', '') AS V7SRVG
FROM thcdnaproddata.staging.nm_visit AS V
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO, SUM(OBSDSQTY) AS OBSDSQTY FROM thcdnaproddata.staging.nm_obshdfile GROUP BY OBSDHOSP, OBSDPATNO) AS O ON V.V7HOSP = O.OBSDHOSP AND V.V7PAT = O.OBSDPATNO
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT nm_pattype_hk AS DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK,TRIM(Q8PTYP) AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD,TRIM(Q8PTPD) AS ENCOUNTER_CD_DESC,CASE WHEN TRIM(UPPER(Q8HOSP)) = 'TRA' AND TRIM(Q8PTCL) = 'E' THEN 'O' ELSE TRIM(Q8PTCL) END AS PATIENT_CLASS_CD, Q8HOSP FROM staging.nm_pattype ) PT ON LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ')) = LOWER(TRIM(PT.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD)) AND TRIM(UPPER(V.V7HOSP)) = TRIM(UPPER(PT.Q8HOSP))
WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(V7LCHD AS STRING)) >= V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT AND
    (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp_thc_src)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
OR (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND v7hosp_thc_src IS NULL)) AND V.V7PAT IS NOT NULL AND ((V.V7ADMD >= 20130101 AND V.V7ADMD <> 99999999 )
    OR (V.V7DISD >= 20130101 AND V.V7DISD <> 99999999) OR (V.V7DISD IS NULL AND V.V7ADMD IS NULL))
);

INSERT INTO fact_encounter_temp (
    PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FACILITY_CD,ADMISSION_DT,DISCHARGE_DT,DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,IP_ENCOUNTERS,IP_DAYS,NICU_DAYS,OBSERVATION_HOURS,
    FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC,LAST_CHANGE_DATE,SOURCE_SYSTEM,PATIENT_CLASS_CD,LENGTH_OF_STAY--,std_rev_grp_code
)
select * except(row_no) from(
SELECT
  TRIM(src.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
  TRIM(src.FACILITY_CD) FACILITY_CD,
  src.ADMISSION_DT,

ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY src.FACILITY_CD,PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,SOURCE_SYSTEM) row_no
FROM PREP_FINAL_INSERT AS src
) where row_no =1;


 --I) Decision Support Case Flag (charges + patient class)
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_decision_support AS
  WITH charges_union AS (
    SELECT TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD, CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
           TRIM(n.V2REVC) AS REVENUE_CD, CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC) AS QTY
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges n
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic' AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > (select max(POSTING_DT) from `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f WHERE ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))) OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)))
      AND ((LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
    FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, REVENUE_CD, CHARGE_QUANTITY AS QTY
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
         AND ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL))
  ),
  dsc_calc AS (
    SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '110' AND '179') OR (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '190' AND '219') THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS qty_incl,
           SUM(CASE WHEN (REVENUE_CD BETWEEN '170' AND '179') AND REVENUE_CD NOT IN ('172','173','174','0172','0173','0174')
               THEN QTY ELSE 0 END) AS qty_excl
    FROM charges_union
    GROUP BY 1,2
  )
  SELECT
    f.FACILITY_CD, f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    CAST(
      CASE
        WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' THEN
          CASE WHEN IFNULL(dc.qty_incl,0) > IFNULL(dc.qty_excl,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ELSE 1
      END AS INT64
    ) AS DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG
  FROM fact_encounter_temp f
  LEFT JOIN dsc_calc dc
    ON dc.FACILITY_CD = f.FACILITY_CD AND dc.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  WHERE f.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG = S.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'DSC_FLAG'
  FROM tmp_decision_support S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );



  --K) IP metrics (uses patient class + DSC)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_ip_metrics AS
  SELECT
    f.FACILITY_CD, f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    CASE WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND COALESCE(ds.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS IP_ENCOUNTERS,
    CASE WHEN f.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND COALESCE(ds.DECISION_SUPPORT_CASE_FLG,0) = 1 THEN f.LENGTH_OF_STAY ELSE 0 END AS IP_DAYS
  FROM fact_encounter_temp f
  LEFT JOIN tmp_decision_support ds
    ON ds.FACILITY_CD = f.FACILITY_CD AND ds.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = f.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  WHERE f.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.IP_ENCOUNTERS = S.IP_ENCOUNTERS,
      T.IP_DAYS       = S.IP_DAYS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'IP_METRICS'
  FROM tmp_ip_metrics S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );


  --L) NICU_DAYS (non-DAAC sources)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_nicu_days AS
  SELECT
    TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD,
    CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SUM(CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC)) AS NICU_DAYS
  FROM `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges n
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic' AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > (select max(POSTING_DT) from `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f WHERE ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))) OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)))
    AND ((LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
         OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL))
    AND TRIM(n.V2REVC) IN ('172','173','174','0172','0173','0174')
  GROUP BY 1,2
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, SUM(CHARGE_QUANTITY) AS NICU_DAYS
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges f
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(f.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
         AND ((LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
           OR (LOWER(TRIM(f.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND f.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL))
           AND f.REVENUE_CD IN ('172','173','174','0172','0173','0174')
  GROUP BY 1,2;


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.NICU_DAYS = S.NICU_DAYS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'NICU_DAYS'
  FROM tmp_nicu_days S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );

  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp F
  SET F.OBSERVATION_HOURS = 0
  WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM IN('BAPTIST_EPIC','EMC_MEDITECH','HIDES_MEDITECH');

  --H) Observation Hours (charges base)
  -- START OPTIMIZED QUERY
CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_observation_hours AS
WITH
  fact_charges_filtered AS (
    -- Pre-filter fact_charges once for the relevant facility and source system.
    -- This avoids scanning the multi-hundred-million row table twice.
    SELECT
      FACILITY_CD,
      PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      CHARGE_QUANTITY,
      CHARGE_NBR,
      POSTING_DT
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata`.idm.fact_charges
    WHERE
      LOWER(TRIM(SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
      -- The original predicate `A OR (A AND B)` is logically equivalent to `A`.
      -- This simplification is correct and improves readability.
      AND LOWER(TRIM(FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
  ),
  max_post_date AS (
    -- Calculate the max posting date from the small, pre-filtered dataset.
    SELECT MAX(POSTING_DT) AS max_dt FROM fact_charges_filtered
  ),
  nm_charges_agg AS (
    -- First branch of the union: Aggregate data from the staging table.
    SELECT
      TRIM(n.V2HOSP) AS FACILITY_CD,
      CAST(n.V2PAT AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      SUM(CAST(n.V2CQTY AS NUMERIC)) AS QTY
    FROM
      `thcdnaproddata`.staging.nm_charges AS n
    CROSS JOIN -- Use the scalar value calculated efficiently in the prior CTE.
      max_post_date
    WHERE
      LOWER(TRIM(n.SOURCE_SYSTEM)) = 'baptist_epic'
      AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(n.v2pstd AS STRING)) > max_post_date.max_dt
      -- This complex filter logic is preserved exactly as it uses two different columns.
      AND (
        (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)))
        OR (LOWER(TRIM(n.V2HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND n.V2HOSP_THC_SRC IS NULL)
      )
      AND TRIM(n.V2CHG) IN ('762000001', '762000002')
    GROUP BY
      1, 2
  ),
  fact_charges_agg AS (
    -- Second branch of the union: Aggregate from the pre-filtered CTE, not the base table.
    SELECT
      FACILITY_CD,
      PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      SUM(CHARGE_QUANTITY) AS QTY
    FROM
      fact_charges_filtered
    WHERE
      CHARGE_NBR IN ('762000001', '762000002')
    GROUP BY
      1, 2
  ),
  obh_epic AS (
    -- UNION ALL is preserved as the sources are different (staging vs. production).
    SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, QTY FROM nm_charges_agg
    UNION ALL
    SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, QTY FROM fact_charges_agg
  )
-- Final join to the encounter data remains unchanged.
SELECT
  F.FACILITY_CD,
  F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
  CASE
    WHEN F.SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'BAPTIST_EPIC' THEN IFNULL(e.QTY, 0)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS OBSERVATION_HOURS
FROM
  fact_encounter_temp AS F
LEFT JOIN
  obh_epic AS e ON e.FACILITY_CD = F.FACILITY_CD AND e.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
WHERE
  F.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC', 'EMC_MEDITECH', 'HIDES_MEDITECH');
-- END OPTIMIZED QUERY;


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.OBSERVATION_HOURS = S.OBSERVATION_HOURS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'OBS_HOURS'
  FROM tmp_observation_hours S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );

MERGE `thcdnaproddata.idm.pre_fact_encounter_covid` AS T

ON T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR

  );

-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)

 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *

FROM (

        THEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7ADMD AS STRING))

      THEN PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7ADMD AS STRING))
      ELSE PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '0001-01-01')

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS
WITH
-- Step 1: Combine the two ICD9 source tables with UNION DISTINCT, as in the original query.
-- This preserves the deduplication logic between the main history table and its backup.
icd9_sources AS (
  SELECT
    daac_icd9diag_hk AS DIM_DIAG_SK,

    (

      OR (LOWER(TRIM(M3HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND TRIM(M3HOSP_THC_SRC) IS NULL)

  SELECT
    daac_icd9diag_hk AS DIM_DIAG_SK,
    TRIM(M3HOSP) AS HOSP_CD,

  WHERE
    (
      LOWER(TRIM(M3HOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(M3HOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND TRIM(M3HOSP_THC_SRC) IS NULL)
    )
),

-- Step 2: Select from the DAAC ICD10 source table.
icd10_daac_source AS (
  SELECT
    daac_icd10diag_hk AS DIM_DIAG_SK,
    TRIM(I10DHOSP) AS HOSP_CD,

    )
),

-- Step 3: Consolidate four scans of `staging.nm_icd10diag` into one.
-- The original four UNION ALL branches covered all combinations of date and SOURCE_SYSTEM,
-- which is equivalent to a single scan with the common facility filter.
icd10_nm_source AS (
  SELECT
    nm_diag_hk AS DIM_DIAG_SK,
    TRIM(I10DHOSP) AS HOSP_CD,

  WHERE
    (
      LOWER(TRIM(I10DHOSP_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(I10DHOSP)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND TRIM(I10DHOSP_THC_SRC) IS NULL)
    )
    -- The original logic used `= 'DAAC'` and `<> 'DAAC'`, which implicitly filters out NULLs.
    -- We make this explicit to guarantee correctness.
    AND SOURCE_SYSTEM IS NOT NULL
),

-- Step 4: Combine all sources with UNION ALL.
all_sources AS (
  SELECT * FROM icd9_sources
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM icd10_daac_source
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM icd10_nm_source
)

  CASE WHEN e.CC_MCC_FLG = 'NULL' THEN NULL ELSE e.CC_MCC_FLG END AS CC_MCC_FLG,
  e.SOURCE_SYSTEM

LEFT JOIN idm.dim_facility AS df
  ON LOWER(TRIM(df.facility_cd)) = LOWER(e.HOSP_CD);

-- 4. Validation Step: Compare the two tables and check optimized duplicates.
-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View discrepancy rows.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES;

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_drg AS
WITH
-- Block 1: Lookup table for DRG classification, unchanged.
mdrgdesc_src AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTR(TMDRG, 2, 3) AS TMDRG,
        CASE
            WHEN TMDRGM = 'S' THEN 'SURG'
            WHEN TMDRGM = 'M' THEN 'MED'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS DRG_CLASSIFICATION
    FROM `thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_mdrgdesc_hist`
),

-- Block 2: Read source data ONCE, join, and compute both row numbers.
-- This materializes the expensive part of the query, avoiding redundant work.
all_ranked_records AS (
    SELECT
        dh.daac_dim_drg_hk,
        'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM,
        CAST(SUBSTR(dh.WRDRG, 2, 3) AS STRING) AS WRDRG,
        dh.WRPAYR,
        dh.WRSTRD,
        dh.WRENDD,
        dh.WRCOSW,
        dh.WRALOS,
        dh.WRARLOS,
        dh.WRDRGD,
        t.DRG_CLASSIFICATION,
        -- Calculate both row numbers in a single pass over the data
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dh.WRDRG, dh.WRSTRD, dh.WRPAYR ORDER BY dh.WRENDD ASC) AS row_num_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dh.WRDRG, dh.WRSTRD, dh.WRPAYR ORDER BY dh.WRENDD DESC) AS row_num_desc
    FROM `thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_drg_hist` AS dh
    LEFT JOIN mdrgdesc_src AS t
      ON CAST(SUBSTR(dh.WRDRG, 2, 3) AS STRING) = t.TMDRG
),

-- Block 3: Replicate the original UNION ALL logic to maintain row counts.
-- This reads the pre-computed 'all_ranked_records' CTE, which is efficient.
combined AS (
    SELECT * EXCEPT(row_num_asc, row_num_desc) FROM all_ranked_records WHERE row_num_asc = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * EXCEPT(row_num_asc, row_num_desc) FROM all_ranked_records WHERE row_num_desc = 1
),

-- Block 4: Apply transformations, same as original 'transformed' CTE.
-- This CTE now operates on the consolidated and pre-filtered data.
transformed AS (
  SELECT
      daac_dim_drg_hk AS DIM_DRG_SK,
      CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(WRDRG), '[ ]+', ' ') AS STRING) AS DRG_CD,
      CAST(
          CASE
              WHEN WRPAYR = 'M' THEN 'MEDICARE MSDRG'
              WHEN WRPAYR = 'C' THEN 'TRICARE DRG'
              ELSE ''
          END AS STRING
      ) AS DRG_TYPE,
      CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(WRDRGD), '[ ]+', ' ') AS STRING) AS DRG_DESC,
      CAST(WRCOSW AS NUMERIC) AS DRG_WEIGHT,
      CAST(WRALOS AS NUMERIC) AS GEOMETRIC_MEAN_LENGTH_OF_STAY,
      CAST(WRARLOS AS NUMERIC) AS ARITHMETIC_MEAN_LENGTH_OF_STAY,
      PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(WRSTRD AS STRING)) AS EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT,
      PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(WRENDD AS STRING)) AS EFFECTIVE_TO_DT,
      SOURCE_SYSTEM,
      DRG_CLASSIFICATION
  FROM combined
),

-- Block 5: Final deduplication, logic is identical to original.
deduped AS (
  SELECT
      *,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY LOWER(DRG_TYPE), LOWER(DRG_CD), EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT, LOWER(SOURCE_SYSTEM)
          ORDER BY EFFECTIVE_TO_DT ASC
      ) AS rn
  FROM transformed
)

CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_drg AS
WITH
-- Block 1: Lookup table for DRG classification, unchanged.
mdrgdesc_src AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTR(TMDRG, 2, 3) AS TMDRG,
        CASE
            WHEN TMDRGM = 'S' THEN 'SURG'
            WHEN TMDRGM = 'M' THEN 'MED'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS DRG_CLASSIFICATION
    FROM `thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_mdrgdesc_hist`
),

-- Block 2: Read source data ONCE, join, and compute both row numbers.
-- This materializes the expensive part of the query, avoiding redundant work.
all_ranked_records AS (
    SELECT
        dh.daac_dim_drg_hk,
        'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM,
        CAST(SUBSTR(dh.WRDRG, 2, 3) AS STRING) AS WRDRG,
        dh.WRPAYR,
        dh.WRSTRD,
        dh.WRENDD,
        dh.WRCOSW,
        dh.WRALOS,
        dh.WRARLOS,
        dh.WRDRGD,
        t.DRG_CLASSIFICATION,
        -- Calculate both row numbers in a single pass over the data
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dh.WRDRG, dh.WRSTRD, dh.WRPAYR ORDER BY dh.WRENDD ASC) AS row_num_asc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dh.WRDRG, dh.WRSTRD, dh.WRPAYR ORDER BY dh.WRENDD DESC) AS row_num_desc
    FROM `thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_drg_hist` AS dh
    LEFT JOIN mdrgdesc_src AS t
      ON CAST(SUBSTR(dh.WRDRG, 2, 3) AS STRING) = t.TMDRG
),

-- Block 3: Replicate the original UNION ALL logic to maintain row counts.
-- This reads the pre-computed 'all_ranked_records' CTE, which is efficient.
combined AS (
    SELECT * EXCEPT(row_num_asc, row_num_desc) FROM all_ranked_records WHERE row_num_asc = 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * EXCEPT(row_num_asc, row_num_desc) FROM all_ranked_records WHERE row_num_desc = 1
),

-- Block 4: Apply transformations, same as original 'transformed' CTE.
-- This CTE now operates on the consolidated and pre-filtered data.
transformed AS (
  SELECT
      daac_dim_drg_hk AS DIM_DRG_SK,
      CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(WRDRG), '[ ]+', ' ') AS STRING) AS DRG_CD,
      CAST(
          CASE
              WHEN WRPAYR = 'M' THEN 'MEDICARE MSDRG'

CREATE PROCEDURE thcdnaproddata.idm.sp_fact_encounter_statfile(IN inparam_facility_cd STRING, OUT OUT_PARAM INT64)
BEGIN
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  -- Proc name    : sp_fact_encounter_statfile
  -- Database     : idm
  -- Author       : Shiva Arun Reddy
  -- Project      : Tenet 2.0 Conversion
  -- Proc Desc    : Stored procedure to load fact_encounter.
  -- Revision History:
  -- When   Version Modified by         Change description
  -- --------  -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  -- 20250917  1.0 Shiva Arun Reddy                Created!
  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

  DECLARE V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT DATE;
  DECLARE V_PROC_NAME STRING DEFAULT 'sp_fact_encounter_statfile';
  DECLARE V_LOG_MESSAGE STRING;
  DECLARE V_FACILITY_CD STRING DEFAULT inparam_facility_cd;
  DECLARE V_ERRORMESSAGE STRING;
  DECLARE V_MYERRORMESSAGE STRING;
  DECLARE min_of_max_dates DATE;
  DECLARE V_RESULT_1,V_RESULT_2 STRING;
  DECLARE DML_1, DML_2 STRING;

  SET V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT = ( SELECT CAST(last_extract_ts AS DATE) FROM
  `thcdnaproddata.idm.data_control_v2` WHERE LOWER(target_table_nm) = 'pre_fact_encounter_statfile' AND process_nm = 'sp_fact_encounter_statfile'
  AND LOWER (TRIM(fac_cd)) = LOWER (TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) ORDER BY load_ts DESC LIMIT 1);


  BEGIN

  CREATE TEMP TABLE fact_encounter_temp
  PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(DISCHARGE_DT, MONTH)
  CLUSTER BY FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AS
  select * from idm.pre_fact_encounter_statfile limit 0;

-- CTE: Combine DAAC and NM visit data
CREATE TEMP TABLE SRC_STAGING_VISIT AS (
SELECT
V.V7HOSP AS HOSP_CD, CAST(V.V7PAT AS STRING) AS PATNO, Trim(V.V7PATT) AS V7PATT, V.V7ADMD, V.V7DISD, NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATC), r'[ ]+', ' '),'') AS PATIENT_CLASS_CD,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ') AS patient_class_type, Trim(V.V7EDFL) AS V7EDFL, Trim(V.V7SUROPFL) AS V7SUROPFL, Trim(V.V7SURIPFL) AS V7SURIPFL,
    CAST(V.V7PATV AS INTEGER) AS V7PATV,
    V.V7ICD, V.V7HOSP_THC_SRC, V.V7LCHD,'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM,
FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.daac_visit_hist AS V
WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(V7LCHD AS STRING)) >= V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT AND
    (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp_thc_src)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
OR (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND v7hosp_thc_src IS NULL)) --AND (V.V7ADMD <> 99999999 OR V.V7DISD <> 99999999)

UNION ALL

SELECT
V.V7HOSP AS HOSP_CD, TRIM(V.V7PAT) AS PATNO, Trim(V.V7PATT) AS V7PATT, V.V7ADMD, V.V7DISD,PT.PATIENT_CLASS_CD,
      REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ') AS patient_class_type, Trim(V.V7EDFL) AS V7EDFL, Trim(V.V7SUROPFL) AS V7SUROPFL, Trim(V.V7SURIPFL) AS V7SURIPFL,
      CAST(V.V7PATV AS INTEGER) AS V7PATV,
      V.ICUFLAG AS V7ICD, V.V7HOSP_THC_SRC, V.V7LCHD,V.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
FROM thcdnaproddata.staging.nm_visit AS V
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT nm_pattype_hk AS DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK,TRIM(Q8PTYP) AS ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD,TRIM(Q8PTPD) AS ENCOUNTER_CD_DESC,CASE WHEN TRIM(UPPER(Q8HOSP)) = 'TRA' AND TRIM(Q8PTCL) = 'E' THEN 'O' ELSE TRIM(Q8PTCL) END AS PATIENT_CLASS_CD, Q8HOSP FROM staging.nm_pattype ) PT ON LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(V.V7PATT), '[ ]+', ' ')) = LOWER(TRIM(PT.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD)) AND TRIM(UPPER(V.V7HOSP)) = TRIM(UPPER(PT.Q8HOSP))
WHERE PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(V7LCHD AS STRING)) >= V_LAST_EXTRACT_DT AND
    (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp_thc_src)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
OR (LOWER(TRIM(v7hosp)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND v7hosp_thc_src IS NULL)) AND V.V7PAT IS NOT NULL AND ((V.V7ADMD >= 20130101 AND V.V7ADMD <> 99999999 )
    OR (V.V7DISD >= 20130101 AND V.V7DISD <> 99999999) OR (V.V7DISD IS NULL AND V.V7ADMD IS NULL))
);

  CREATE TEMP TABLE SRC_STATFILE_INT AS ( SELECT HOSP_CD, PATNO, SOURCE_SYSTEM, STSQTY FROM(
SELECT TRIM(STHOSP) AS HOSP_CD, TRIM(REPLACE(CAST(CAST(STPATNO AS BIGNUMERIC) AS STRING), ".","")) AS PATNO, SOURCE_SYSTEM, SUM(STSQTY) AS STSQTY,
FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.statfile_intg
WHERE STTYPE IN('ADM','DIS') AND STPGRP = 'REHAB' AND SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'DAAC'
    AND STHOSP NOT IN('BMA','NCA','NBH','SLH','MTB','LMF','SVH','FUH','CSM','CSK','CHF','DCR','DDR','DHR','DHV','DSH','DRA')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT TRIM(STHOSP) AS HOSP_CD, TRIM(CAST(STPATNO AS STRING)) AS PATNO, SOURCE_SYSTEM, SUM(STSQTY) AS STSQTY,
FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.statfile_intg
WHERE STTYPE IN('ADM','DIS') AND STPGRP = 'REHAB' AND SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'DAAC' AND STHOSP IN('CSM','CSK','CHF')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT TRIM(STHOSP) AS HOSP_CD, TRIM(CAST(STPATNO AS STRING)) AS PATNO, 'DAAC' AS SOURCE_SYSTEM, SUM(STSQTY) AS STSQTY,
FROM thcdnaproddata.daac_ods.statfile_intg
WHERE STTYPE IN('ADM','DIS') AND STPGRP = 'REHAB' AND STHOSP IN('BMA','NCA','NBH','SLH','MTB','LMF','SVH','FUH', 'DCR','DDR','DHR','DHV','DSH','DRA')
GROUP BY 1,2
  )QUALIFY (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(HOSP_CD), LOWER(PATNO), LOWER(SOURCE_SYSTEM))) = 1
);

CREATE TEMP TABLE XFM_KEYS AS (

WITH stg_visit_cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(HOSP_CD), '[ ]+', ' ') AS HOSP_CODE,
    CASE WHEN REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(UPPER(HOSP_CD)), '[ ]+', ' ') = 'TRA' THEN 'DAAC_TRA' ELSE SOURCE_SYSTEM END AS SOURCE_SYSTEM,
    PATNO, V7ADMD, V7DISD, V7EDFL, V7SUROPFL, V7PATV, V7ICD,V7SURIPFL,
    V7HOSP_THC_SRC, V7LCHD,
    PATIENT_CLASS_CD

  FROM SRC_STAGING_VISIT
)

SELECT
  t1.*,
  CAST(CASE WHEN IFNULL(t1.PATIENT_CLASS_CD, '') = 'I' AND IFNULL(t5.STSQTY, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT64) AS REHAB_FLG,
FROM stg_visit_cleaned AS t1
LEFT JOIN SRC_STATFILE_INT AS t5
  ON t1.HOSP_CODE = t5.HOSP_CD AND t1.PATNO = t5.PATNO
);


CREATE TEMP TABLE DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE AS (
  WITH rehab_source AS (
    SELECT
      SUBSTR(TRIM(MAPPING_TYPE), 1, 2) AS VISIT_TYPE,
      TRIM(CODE) AS CODE,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY LOWER(SUBSTR(TRIM(MAPPING_TYPE), 1, 2)), LOWER(TRIM(CODE))
        ORDER BY CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago") DESC
      ) AS RNK
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.staging.service_line_mapping
    WHERE TRIM(CODE) = '945'
  )
  SELECT
    `thcdnaproddata.framework_metadata.createhashkey`(
      VISIT_TYPE, CODE,
      NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
      NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
      NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
      NULL, NULL, NULL
    ) AS DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK,
    1 AS REHAB_FLG
  FROM rehab_source
  WHERE RNK = 1
);


-- CTE: Prepare the data for the final insert format
CREATE TEMP TABLE PREP_FINAL_INSERT AS (
SELECT
t6.REHAB_FLG, t10.DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK AS DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK,
    CAST(CASE WHEN t6.V7EDFL = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT64) AS EMERGENCY_ROOM_FLG,
    CAST(CASE WHEN t6.V7SUROPFL = 'Y' OR t6.V7SURIPFL = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT64) AS SURGERY_FLG,
    t6.V7PATV AS OP_ENCOUNTERS,
    CAST(CASE WHEN t6.SOURCE_SYSTEM <> 'DAAC' THEN CAST(t6.V7ICD AS INT64) ELSE CASE WHEN t6.V7ICD > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS INT64) AS ICU_FLG,
    CAST(t6.PATNO AS STRING) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, t6.HOSP_CODE as FACILITY_CD, t6.V7HOSP_THC_SRC as FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC,
    SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', CAST(t6.V7LCHD AS STRING)) AS LAST_CHANGE_DATE, SOURCE_SYSTEM,PATIENT_CLASS_CD
    FROM XFM_KEYS AS t6
    LEFT JOIN DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE t10 ON t6.REHAB_FLG = t10.REHAB_FLG
);


INSERT INTO fact_encounter_temp (
    DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FACILITY_CD, REHAB_FLG, EMERGENCY_ROOM_FLG, SURGERY_FLG, OP_ENCOUNTERS, ICU_FLG,
    FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC,LAST_CHANGE_DATE,SOURCE_SYSTEM,PATIENT_CLASS_CD
)
select * except(row_no) from(
SELECT
  IFNULL(src.DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK, '-99'),
  TRIM(src.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
  TRIM(src.FACILITY_CD) FACILITY_CD,
  src.REHAB_FLG,
  src.EMERGENCY_ROOM_FLG,
  src.SURGERY_FLG,
  src.OP_ENCOUNTERS,
  src.ICU_FLG,
  src.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC,
  src.LAST_CHANGE_DATE,
  src.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
  src.PATIENT_CLASS_CD,
ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY FACILITY_CD,PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,SOURCE_SYSTEM) row_no
FROM PREP_FINAL_INSERT AS src
) where row_no =1;


 CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_er_surgery_flags AS
   WITH
    unioned_stats AS (
      SELECT
        F.FACILITY_CD,
        F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
        F.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
        ST.STTYPE,
        ST.STSQTY
      FROM
        fact_encounter_temp F
      LEFT JOIN
        `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg ST
        ON TRIM(F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(ST.STPATNO)
        AND TRIM(F.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(ST.STHOSP)
      WHERE
        ST.SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'AVEGA'
        AND F.FACILITY_CD NOT IN ('CHF','CSK','CSM','EMC','HMD','CMB','PMF','SMQ','WMI','BMA','NCA','NBH','SLH','MTB','LMF','SVH','FUH')

      UNION ALL

      SELECT
        F.FACILITY_CD,
        F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
        F.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
        ST.STTYPE,
        ST.STSQTY
      FROM
        fact_encounter_temp F
      LEFT JOIN
        `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg ST
        ON TRIM(F.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(ST.STHOSP)
        AND TRIM(F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(CASE
            WHEN ST.STHOSP IN ('EMC', 'HMD') THEN SUBSTRING(ST.STPATNO, 4)
            WHEN ST.STHOSP IN ('BMC', 'CMB', 'PMF', 'SMQ', 'WMI') THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(ST.STPATNO, '.', ''), '0')
            ELSE ST.STPATNO
          END)
      WHERE
        F.FACILITY_CD IN ('EMC','HMD','CMB','PMF','SMQ','WMI')
        AND F.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC')
    )

  SELECT
    FACILITY_CD,
    PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SOURCE_SYSTEM,
    CAST((CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN STTYPE = 'ER' THEN STSQTY ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SMALLINT) EMERGENCY_ROOM_FLG,
    CAST((CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN STTYPE = 'SUR' THEN STSQTY ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SMALLINT) SURGERY_FLG
  FROM
    unioned_stats
  GROUP BY
  1, 2, 3;

  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET
  T.EMERGENCY_ROOM_FLG = S.EMERGENCY_ROOM_FLG,
  T.SURGERY_FLG = S.SURGERY_FLG
  -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
  -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'STATFILE_FLAGS'
  FROM tmp_er_surgery_flags S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = S.FACILITY_CD
  AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  AND TRIM(T.SOURCE_SYSTEM) = S.SOURCE_SYSTEM
  AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );

  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_rehab_flags AS
  WITH base_data AS (
    SELECT
      F.FACILITY_CD,
      F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      F.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
      CAST(CASE
        WHEN F.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND RH.STSQTY > 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END AS INT64) AS REHAB_FLG
    FROM fact_encounter_temp F
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        TRIM(STHOSP) AS HOSP_CD,
        TRIM(STPATNO) AS PATNO,
        SUM(STSQTY) AS STSQTY
      FROM `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg
      WHERE STTYPE IN ('ADM','DIS')
        AND STPGRP = 'REHAB'
        AND STHOSP NOT IN ('CHF','CSK','CSM')
        AND STHOSP IN ('DCR','DDR','DHR','DHV','DRA','DSH')
      GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) RH
      ON TRIM(F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = RH.PATNO
      AND TRIM(F.FACILITY_CD) = RH.HOSP_CD
    WHERE F.FACILITY_CD IN ('DCR','DDR','DHR','DHV','DRA','DSH')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      F.FACILITY_CD,
      F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      F.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
      CAST(CASE
        WHEN F.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I' AND RH.STSQTY > 0 THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END AS INT64) AS REHAB_FLG
    FROM  fact_encounter_temp F
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT
        TRIM(STHOSP) AS HOSP_CD,
        CASE
          WHEN STHOSP IN ('EMC', 'HMD') THEN SUBSTRING(STPATNO, 4)
          WHEN STHOSP IN ('CMB','PMF','SMQ','WMI') THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(STPATNO, '.', ''), '0')
          ELSE STPATNO
        END AS PATNO,
        SUM(STSQTY) AS STSQTY
      FROM `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg
      WHERE STTYPE IN ('ADM','DIS')
        AND STPGRP = 'REHAB'
        AND STHOSP IN ('CHF','CSK','CSM','EMC','HMD','CMB','PMF','SMQ','WMI','BMA','NCA','NBH','SLH','MTB','LMF','SVH','FUH')
        AND STHOSP IN ('EMC','HMD','CMB','PMF','SMQ')
      GROUP BY 1, 2
    ) RH
      ON TRIM(F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = RH.PATNO
      AND TRIM(F.FACILITY_CD) = RH.HOSP_CD
    WHERE F.FACILITY_CD IN ('EMC','HMD','CMB','PMF','SMQ')
      AND F.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN ('BAPTIST_EPIC')
  ),
  REHAB AS (
    SELECT
      TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(BD.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, r'[ ]+', ' ')) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(BD.FACILITY_CD, r'[ ]+', ' ')) AS FACILITY_CD,
      BD.SOURCE_SYSTEM,
      BD.REHAB_FLG,
      COALESCE(DR.DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK, '-99') AS DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK
    FROM base_data BD
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK,
        1 AS REHAB_FLG
      FROM DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE
    ) DR
      ON BD.REHAB_FLG = DR.REHAB_FLG
  )
  SELECT
    PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    FACILITY_CD,
    SOURCE_SYSTEM,
    REHAB_FLG,
    DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK
  FROM REHAB
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FACILITY_CD, SOURCE_SYSTEM
    ORDER BY REHAB_FLG DESC
  ) = 1;

  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET
  T.REHAB_FLG = S.REHAB_FLG,
  T.DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK = S.DIM_REHAB_ADJ_SERVICE_LINE_SK
  -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
  -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'STATFILE_FLAGS'
  FROM tmp_rehab_flags S
  WHERE T.FACILITY_CD = S.FACILITY_CD
  AND T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
  AND T.SOURCE_SYSTEM = S.SOURCE_SYSTEM
  AND (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL));

  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_op_enc_daac AS
  SELECT
    TRIM(AE.FACILITY_CD) AS FACILITY_CD,
    TRIM(AE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (ST.STTYPE = 'ER' AND ST.STPGRP = 'OUT')
               OR (ST.STTYPE = 'SUR' AND ST.STPGRP = 'OUT')
               OR (ST.STTYPE = 'VIS')
             THEN ST.STSQTY ELSE 0 END) AS OP_ENCOUNTERS
  FROM fact_encounter_temp AE
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT * FROM `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg
    WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'AVEGA' AND STADMD <= 20200731
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg
    WHERE SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'DAAC' AND STADMD > 20200731
  ) ST
    ON TRIM(AE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(ST.STPATNO)
   AND TRIM(AE.FACILITY_CD)        = TRIM(ST.STHOSP)
  WHERE AE.FACILITY_CD IN ('DCR','DDR','DHR','DHV','DSH','DRA')
    AND ST.STPATNO IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1,2;


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.OP_ENCOUNTERS = S.OP_ENCOUNTERS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'OP_ENC_DAAC'
  FROM tmp_op_enc_daac S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );


  CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_op_enc_epic AS
  SELECT
    TRIM(AE.FACILITY_CD) AS FACILITY_CD,
    TRIM(AE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (ST.STTYPE = 'ER' AND ST.STPGRP = 'OUT')
               OR (ST.STTYPE = 'SUR' AND ST.STPGRP = 'OUT')
               OR (ST.STTYPE = 'VIS')
             THEN ST.STSQTY ELSE 0 END) AS OP_ENCOUNTERS
  FROM fact_encounter_temp AE
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CASE
             WHEN STHOSP='EMC' THEN SUBSTRING(STPATNO,4)
             WHEN STHOSP='HMD' THEN SUBSTRING(STPATNO,4)
             WHEN STHOSP IN ('CMB','PMF','SMQ','WMI') THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(STPATNO,'.',''),'0')
             ELSE STPATNO
           END AS STPATNO, STHOSP, STSQTY, STTYPE, STPGRP
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg
  ) ST
    ON TRIM(AE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(ST.STPATNO)
   AND TRIM(AE.FACILITY_CD)        = TRIM(ST.STHOSP)
  WHERE AE.SOURCE_SYSTEM IN('BAPTIST_EPIC')
  GROUP BY 1,2;


  UPDATE fact_encounter_temp T
  SET T.OP_ENCOUNTERS = S.OP_ENCOUNTERS
      -- T.UPDATE_TS = CURRENT_DATETIME("America/Chicago"),
      -- T.UPDATE_UID = 'OP_ENC_EPIC'
  FROM tmp_op_enc_epic S
  WHERE TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD) = TRIM(S.FACILITY_CD)
    AND TRIM(T.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR) = TRIM(S.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR)
    AND (
      LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))
      OR (LOWER(TRIM(T.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) AND T.FACILITY_CD_THC_SRC IS NULL)
    );

   CREATE TEMP TABLE tmp_icu_flag AS
  WITH icu_statfile AS (
    SELECT
      s.STHOSP AS FACILITY_CD,
      CASE
        WHEN s.STHOSP IN ('EMC','HMD') THEN SUBSTRING(s.STPATNO,4)
        WHEN s.STHOSP IN ('CMB','PMF','SMQ','WMI') THEN LTRIM(REPLACE(s.STPATNO,'.',''),'0')
        ELSE TRIM(s.STPATNO)
      END AS PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
      SUM(CASE WHEN s.STCCTR IN ('3010','3015','3016','3020','3021','3040','3060','3061','3064','3066')
               THEN CAST(s.STSAMT AS NUMERIC) ELSE 0 END) AS CHARGE
    FROM `thcdnaproddata`.daac_ods.statfile_intg s
    WHERE s.STHOSP IN ('CMB','PMF','SMQ','WMI')
    GROUP BY 1,2
  )
