CREATE PROCEDURE thcdnaproddata.idm.sp_fact_modified_anr_load(IN inparam_facility_cd STRING, OUT OUT_PARAM INT64)
BEGIN

  /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  -- Proc name  : sp_fact_modified_anr_load
  -- Proc Desc  : Calculates MODIFIED_ANR using Plan, SRG, and Patient Class, and loads minimal data to a target table.
  /* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  DECLARE V_FACILITY_CD STRING DEFAULT inparam_facility_cd;
  DECLARE V_SQL STRING;

  -- 1. Create and Load the Base Data Temp Table (Requires all three granularity columns)
  CREATE TEMP TABLE temp_fact_encounter_anr_hist_base_data CLUSTER BY DISCHARGE_DT AS
  ( 
    SELECT 
      DF.MRKT_ID, FE.FACILITY_CD, FE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FE.DISCHARGE_DT, 
      DET.PATIENT_CLASS_CD, DHP.PLAN_ID, DSRG.SRG9_CD, 
      FE.TOTAL_CHARGES, FE.ADJUSTED_NET_REV, FE.PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS,
      CASE 
        WHEN (DF.MRKT_ID IN ('M21', 'M13')) THEN 'ANR' 
        WHEN (DF.MRKT_ID IN ('M16') OR DF.FACILITY_CD IN ('HMD','EMC')) THEN 'PAYMENTS' 
      END AS CALC_FIELD
    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_encounter FE 
    INNER join thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_facility DF ON FE.DIM_FACILITY_SK = DF.DIM_FACILITY_SK
    LEFT join thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_health_plan DHP ON FE.DIM_HEALTH_PLAN_SK = DHP.DIM_HEALTH_PLAN_SK AND DHP.DIM_HEALTH_PLAN_SK <> '-99'
    LEFT join thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_std_rev_grp DSRG ON FE.DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK = DSRG.DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK AND DSRG.DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK <> '-99'
    LEFT join thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_encounter_type DET ON FE.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK = DET.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK AND DET.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK <> '-99'
    WHERE (
      (DF.MRKT_ID IN ('M21', 'M13') AND COALESCE(TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) <> COALESCE(ADJUSTED_NET_REV, 0)) 
      OR (DF.MRKT_ID IN ('M16') AND COALESCE(PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS, 0) <> 0)
      OR (DF.FACILITY_CD IN ('HMD','EMC') AND COALESCE(PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS, 0) <> 0)
    ) 
    AND DET.PATIENT_CLASS_CD IN ('I','O')
    AND FE.DISCHARGE_DT >= DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( DATE_ADD((CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago')), INTERVAL - 36 MONTH),QUARTER ),INTERVAL  -15 MONTH)
    and (LOWER(TRIM(FE.FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD))));

  -- 2. Create and Load the Summary Temp Table (Historical Rates: Plan and SRG)
  --    This logic uses all three columns for grouping as per the requirement.
  CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE temp_fact_encounter_anr_hist_summary CLUSTER BY FROM_DISCHARGE_DT, TO_DISCHARGE_DT AS
  WITH ANR_PLAN_HIST AS 
  (
    SELECT 
      DT.FROM_DISCHARGE_DT, DT.TO_DISCHARGE_DT, FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_CLASS_CD, PLAN_ID, 
      CAST('PLAN' AS STRING) AS MEASURE_GROUP, CALC_FIELD AS MEASURE_NM, 
      CAST(AVG(TOTAL_CHARGES) AS NUMERIC) AS AVG_TOTAL_CHARGES,
      CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'ANR' THEN CAST(ADJUSTED_NET_REV AS FLOAT64) WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'PAYMENTS' THEN CAST(PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) AS NUMERIC) AS MEASURE_VALUE,
      CAST(CASE WHEN CAST(AVG(TOTAL_CHARGES) AS NUMERIC) <> 0 THEN CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'ANR' THEN CAST(ADJUSTED_NET_REV AS FLOAT64) WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'PAYMENTS' THEN CAST(PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) AS NUMERIC) * 100.00 / CAST(CAST(AVG(TOTAL_CHARGES) AS NUMERIC) AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END AS NUMERIC) AS MEASURE_PERCENT,
      CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'ANR' THEN ADJUSTED_NET_REV WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'PAYMENTS' THEN PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS ELSE NULL END) AS INT64) AS RECORD_COUNT
    FROM temp_fact_encounter_anr_hist_base_data Q1 
    CROSS JOIN (
      SELECT cast(DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'),QUARTER),INTERVAL -15  MONTH),interval - (IDX*3) MONTH) as datetime) AS FROM_DISCHARGE_DT,
      CAST(DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'),QUARTER),INTERVAL -3  MONTH),INTERVAL - (IDX*3)  MONTH)-1 as datetime) AS TO_DISCHARGE_DT
      FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 1023)) AS IDX
      WHERE cast(DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'),QUARTER),INTERVAL -15  MONTH),INTERVAL - (IDX*3) MONTH) as datetime)
      >= DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'), INTERVAL - 36 MONTH),QUARTER ),INTERVAL  -15 MONTH)
    ) DT
    WHERE Q1.DISCHARGE_DT BETWEEN DT.FROM_DISCHARGE_DT AND DT.TO_DISCHARGE_DT
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
    HAVING RECORD_COUNT >= 3
  ) 
  , ANR_SRG_HIST AS 
  (
    SELECT 
      DT.FROM_DISCHARGE_DT, DT.TO_DISCHARGE_DT, FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_CLASS_CD, SRG9_CD, 
      CAST('SRG' AS STRING) AS MEASURE_GROUP, CALC_FIELD AS MEASURE_NM, 
      CAST(AVG(TOTAL_CHARGES) AS NUMERIC) AS AVG_TOTAL_CHARGES,
      CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'ANR' THEN CAST(ADJUSTED_NET_REV AS FLOAT64) WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'PAYMENTS' THEN CAST(PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) AS NUMERIC) AS MEASURE_VALUE,
      CAST(CASE WHEN CAST(AVG(TOTAL_CHARGES) AS NUMERIC) <> 0 THEN (CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'ANR' THEN CAST(ADJUSTED_NET_REV AS FLOAT64) WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'PAYMENTS' THEN CAST(PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END) AS NUMERIC)) * 100.00 / CAST(CAST(AVG(TOTAL_CHARGES) AS NUMERIC) AS FLOAT64) ELSE NULL END AS NUMERIC) AS MEASURE_PERCENT,
      CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'ANR' THEN ADJUSTED_NET_REV WHEN CALC_FIELD = 'PAYMENTS' THEN PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS ELSE NULL END) AS INT64) AS RECORD_COUNT
    FROM temp_fact_encounter_anr_hist_base_data Q1 
    CROSS JOIN (
      SELECT cast(DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'),QUARTER),INTERVAL -15  MONTH),interval - (IDX*3) MONTH) as datetime) AS FROM_DISCHARGE_DT,
      CAST(DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'),QUARTER),INTERVAL -3  MONTH),INTERVAL - (IDX*3)  MONTH)-1 as datetime) AS TO_DISCHARGE_DT
      FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 1023)) AS IDX
      WHERE cast(DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'),QUARTER),INTERVAL -15  MONTH),INTERVAL - (IDX*3) MONTH) as datetime)
      >= DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC( DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE('America/Chicago'), INTERVAL - 36 MONTH),QUARTER ),INTERVAL  -15 MONTH)
    ) DT
    WHERE Q1.DISCHARGE_DT BETWEEN DT.FROM_DISCHARGE_DT AND DT.TO_DISCHARGE_DT
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7
    HAVING RECORD_COUNT >= 3
  )
  SELECT * FROM ANR_PLAN_HIST
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM ANR_SRG_HIST;

  -- 3. Calculate MODIFIED_ANR and Insert into Target Table
  
  delete from idm.fact_encounter_modified_anr where LOWER(TRIM(FACILITY_CD)) = LOWER(TRIM(V_FACILITY_CD)) ;

  INSERT INTO idm.fact_encounter_modified_anr
  (
    FACILITY_CD,
    PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,
    MODIFIED_ANR
  )
  SELECT 
    ENC.FACILITY_CD, 
    ENC.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, 
    CAST(ROUND(
      CASE 
        WHEN (CASE 
          WHEN ENC.SRG9_CD = '65' THEN 2
          WHEN H1.MEASURE_PERCENT <> 0 THEN H1.MEASURE_PERCENT
          WHEN H2.MEASURE_PERCENT <> 0 THEN H2.MEASURE_PERCENT
          ELSE NULL
        END) <> 0 THEN ((CASE 
          WHEN ENC.SRG9_CD = '65' THEN 2
          WHEN H1.MEASURE_PERCENT <> 0 THEN H1.MEASURE_PERCENT
          WHEN H2.MEASURE_PERCENT <> 0 THEN H2.MEASURE_PERCENT
          ELSE NULL
        END) * CAST(ENC.TOTAL_CHARGES AS FLOAT64)) / 100.00
        ELSE DEFAULT_ANR
      END, 2) AS NUMERIC) AS MODIFIED_ANR
  FROM  
    (
      SELECT 
        DF.MRKT_ID, FE.FACILITY_CD, FE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FE.DISCHARGE_DT, 
        DET.PATIENT_CLASS_CD, DHP.PLAN_ID, DSRG.SRG9_CD, 
        FE.TOTAL_CHARGES, FE.PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS, FE.ADJUSTED_NET_REV,
        DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(FE.DISCHARGE_DT,QUARTER),INTERVAL -15  MONTH) AS ANR_HIST_BEGIN_DT,
        DATE_ADD(DATE_TRUNC(FE.DISCHARGE_DT,QUARTER),INTERVAL -3  MONTH)-1 AS ANR_HIST_END_DT,
        CASE
          WHEN DF.MRKT_ID IN ('M21', 'M13') THEN FE.ADJUSTED_NET_REV

          WHEN DF.FACILITY_CD IN ('HMD','EMC') THEN FE.PA_TOTAL_PAYMENTS
        END AS DEFAULT_ANR
      FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_encounter FE             
      INNER join thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_facility DF ON FE.DIM_FACILITY_SK = DF.DIM_FACILITY_SK

    LEFT JOIN excluded_hf eh ON ah.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = eh.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND ah.FACILITY_CD = eh.FACILITY_CD
    WHERE eh.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR IS NULL
  ),
  all_diag AS (
    SELECT
      F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD,
      MAX(CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 THEN D.DIAG_CD END) AS DIAG_CD1,
      ARRAY_AGG(CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR NOT IN (0, 1) AND F.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT = 'Y' THEN D.DIAG_CD END IGNORE NULLS) AS DIAG_CD2_ARRAY
    FROM Diagnosis_base F
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D ON F.DIM_DIAG_SK = D.DIM_DIAG_SK
    WHERE D.DIAG_CD IS NOT NULL AND (F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 OR F.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT = 'Y')

  ),
  all_diag_and_pn_readmit_grouped AS (
    SELECT
      fd.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, fd.FACILITY_CD,
      MAX(CASE WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' AND (SUBSTRING(fd.DIAG_CD1, 1, 1) = 'J' OR fd.DIAG_CD1 = 'A481') THEN 2 WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' AND SUBSTRING(fd.DIAG_CD1, 1, 1) <> 'J' THEN 1 END) AS CASE1_SUM,
      MAX(CASE WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' THEN 1 WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL' THEN 4 END) AS CASE2_SUM
    FROM all_diag fd, UNNEST(fd.DIAG_CD2_ARRAY) as DIAG_CD2
    LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re1 ON re1.DIAG_CONDITION = 'PN' AND re1.SEQUENCE_NBR = 1 AND fd.DIAG_CD1 = re1.DIAG_PROC_CD
    LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re2 ON re2.DIAG_CONDITION = 'PN' AND re2.SEQUENCE_NBR = 2 AND DIAG_CD2 = re2.DIAG_PROC_CD
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ),
  pn_data AS (
    SELECT Z.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, Z.FACILITY_CD, 'PN' AS DP_TYPE
    FROM all_diag_and_pn_readmit_grouped Z
    WHERE CASE WHEN COALESCE(Z.CASE1_SUM, 0) = 2 THEN 2 ELSE COALESCE(Z.CASE1_SUM, 0) + COALESCE(Z.CASE2_SUM, 0) END = 2
  ),
  all_thk_procs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT FP.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FP.FACILITY_CD, FP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK, CASE WHEN FP.PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR, DP.PROCEDURE_CD

  ),
  grouped_thks_proc AS (
    SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
    FROM (
        SELECT ath.FACILITY_CD, ath.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, CASE WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' THEN 0 WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL <> 'INCL' THEN 1 WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL' THEN 1 WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL <> 'EXCL' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS CRITERIA
        FROM all_thk_procs ath
        LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re1 ON ath.PROCEDURE_CD = re1.DIAG_PROC_CD AND ath.PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR = re1.SEQUENCE_NBR AND re1.DIAG_CONDITION = 'THK/TKA' AND re1.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'PROC_CD' AND re1.SEQUENCE_NBR = 1

    HAVING SUM(CRITERIA) = 0
  ),
  grouped_thks_diag AS (

            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD, CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 THEN 1 WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR NOT IN (0, 1) THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS DIAG_SEQ_NBR, D.DIAG_CD

  ),

        FROM Diagnosis_base F
        JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D ON F.DIM_DIAG_SK = D.DIM_DIAG_SK
    ) ic
    GROUP BY ic.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, ic.FACILITY_CD
    HAVING (CASE WHEN MAX(ic.DIAG_CD1) = 2 THEN 2 ELSE MAX(ic.DIAG_CD1) + MAX(ic.DIAG_CD2) END = 2)
  ),
  all_data_combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM ami_and_stroke_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM cabg_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM hf_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM pn_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM thk_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM copd_data
  ),
  -- Optimization: Identify COVID encounters in a single scan.
  covid_encounters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT FD.FACILITY_CD, FD.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
    FROM Diagnosis_base FD
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D2 ON FD.DIM_DIAG_SK = D2.DIM_DIAG_SK
    WHERE D2.DIAG_CD = 'U071' AND (FD.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 OR FD.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT = 'Y')
  ),
  base_encounter_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT F.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER, F.FACILITY_CD
    FROM Encounter_base F
    INNER JOIN all_data_combined V ON F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = V.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND F.FACILITY_CD = V.FACILITY_CD
  )
SELECT
  F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD, F.DIM_ADMITTING_PHYSICIAN_SK, F.DIM_ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_SK, F.ADMISSION_DT, F.DISCHARGE_DT, F.SOURCE_SYSTEM, F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD, F.ADMIT_SOURCE_CD, COALESCE(VE.DP_TYPE, 'XXX') AS DP_TYPE, DP.MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR, F.DIM_HOSP_SERVICE_SK, F.DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK, DP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
  CASE
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN ('THK/TKA') AND (F.ADMIT_SOURCE_CD IN ('E', 'Z', '4') OR F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN ('02','05','07','43','63','65','66','82','85','88','91','93','94','20','41') OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365) THEN 1
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN ('AMI','HF','PN','COPD','STROKE') AND (F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN ('02','05','07','43','63','65','66','82','85','88','91','93','94','20','41') OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365 OR DE.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD = '8') THEN 1
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN ('CABG') AND (F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN ('07','20','41') OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365 OR DE.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD = '8') THEN 1
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IS NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS NOT_INDEX_FLG,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DP.MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD ORDER BY F.DISCHARGE_DT ASC) AS RANK1
FROM Encounter_base F
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_encounter_type DE ON F.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK = DE.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_patient DP ON F.DIM_PATIENT_SK = DP.DIM_PATIENT_SK AND F.FACILITY_CD = DP.FACILITY_CD
INNER JOIN base_encounter_keys XXX ON F.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = XXX.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER AND F.FACILITY_CD = XXX.FACILITY_CD
LEFT JOIN all_data_combined VE ON F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = VE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND F.FACILITY_CD = VE.FACILITY_CD
-- Optimization: Replaced NOT IN with a safer and more performant LEFT JOIN/IS NULL pattern.
LEFT JOIN covid_encounters ce ON F.FACILITY_CD = ce.FACILITY_CD AND F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = ce.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
WHERE
  F.DISCHARGE_DT >= PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', '20151001')
  AND DE.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I'
  AND DP.LAST_NM NOT LIKE 'ZZTEST%'
  AND DP.LAST_NM NOT LIKE 'ZZZTEST%'
  AND F.TOTAL_CHARGES > 0
  AND F.ACUTE_FLG = 1
  AND DATE_DIFF(F.ADMISSION_DT, DP.DATE_OF_BIRTH, MONTH) / 12 >= 18
  AND ce.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR IS NULL
ORDER BY RANK1

                          AND re.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'PROC_CD'
                          AND DP.PROCEDURE_CD = re.DIAG_PROC_CD
                          AND re.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL'
                      WHERE DP.PROCEDURE_TYPE_CD = 'ICD10'
                          AND FP.FACILITY_CD =V_FACILITY_CD --TODO-  change to variable
              ),

                  SELECT DISTINCT fe.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, fe.FACILITY_CD, re.DIAG_CONDITION
                    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_encounter fe
                    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D1
                        ON fe.DIM_PRIMARY_ICD10_DIAG_SK = D1.DIM_DIAG_SK

                          AND ah.FACILITY_CD = eh.FACILITY_CD
                      WHERE eh.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR is NULL

              all_diag as (
                  SELECT DISTINCT F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD,
                          CASE WHEN (F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1) THEN D.DIAG_CD ELSE NULL END AS DIAG_CD1,
                          CASE WHEN (((F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR <> 0) AND (F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR <> 1)) AND (F.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT = 'Y'))

                  FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_diagnosis F
                  JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D ON F.DIM_DIAG_SK = D.DIM_DIAG_SK

              copd_data  as (

                      FROM initial_copd ic
                      GROUP BY ic.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, ic.FACILITY_CD
                      HAVING ( CASE WHEN  MAX(ic.DIAG_CD1) =2 THEN 2
                          ELSE  MAX(ic.DIAG_CD1) +  MAX(ic.DIAG_CD2)  END = 2   )
              ),
              all_data_combined as (
                  SELECT * FROM ami_and_stroke_data
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT * FROM cabg_data
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT * FROM hf_data
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT * FROM pn_data
                  UNION ALL
                  SELECT * FROM thk_data
                  UNION ALL

              ), no_covid as (
                  SELECT  FD.FACILITY_CD,FD.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FD.FACILITY_CD||FD.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR fc_pan ,
                      SUM( CASE WHEN ( (FD.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR=1 AND D2.DIAG_CD='U071' )

                        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) WithCovid
                  FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_diagnosis FD
                  LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D2 ON FD.DIM_DIAG_SK = D2.DIM_DIAG_SK
                  WHERE facility_cd = V_FACILITY_CD
                  GROUP BY FD.FACILITY_CD,FD.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
                  HAVING WithCovid = 0
              ), with_covid as (  -- this is from px_sp_fact_readmissions all the cte above this is from v_encounter_icd10_inclusion
                  SELECT distinct FD.FACILITY_CD||FD.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR FC_PAN
                      FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_diagnosis FD
                      LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D2 ON FD.DIM_DIAG_SK = D2.DIM_DIAG_SK
                      WHERE (CASE WHEN ( (FD.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR=1 AND D2.DIAG_CD='U071' )
                                                  OR (FD.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR>=2 AND D2.DIAG_CD='U071' AND FD.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT='Y' )
                                              ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) =1
                          AND FD.FACILITY_CD = V_FACILITY_CD  -- TODO Change to variable
              ),
              encounter_icd10_inclusion AS  (
                  SELECT a.*
                      FROM all_data_combined a
                      LEFT JOIN  no_covid c
                          ON   a.FACILITY_CD=c.FACILITY_CD
                          AND a.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR =  c.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
              ),
              base_encounter as (
                  SELECT DISTINCT F.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER,F.FACILITY_CD
                    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_encounter F
                    INNER JOIN  encounter_icd10_inclusion  V  -- TODO Change to variable
                        ON F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = V.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
                        AND F.FACILITY_CD = V.FACILITY_CD )
                SELECT F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR,F.FACILITY_CD,F.DIM_ADMITTING_PHYSICIAN_SK,F.DIM_ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_SK,
                      F.ADMISSION_DT,F.DISCHARGE_DT,F.SOURCE_SYSTEM,F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD,F.ADMIT_SOURCE_CD,
                      CASE WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IS NULL THEN 'XXX' ELSE VE.DP_TYPE END DP_TYPE,
                      DP.MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR, F.DIM_HOSP_SERVICE_SK,F.DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK,DP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
                      CASE WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN('THK/TKA') AND (F.ADMIT_SOURCE_CD IN('E','Z','4')
                            OR DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN('02','05','07','43','63','65','66','82','85','88','91','93','94','20','41')
                            OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365) THEN 1
                          WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN('AMI','HF','PN','COPD','STROKE')
                            AND (DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN('02','05','07','43','63','65','66','82','85','88','91','93','94','20','41')
                            OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365 OR DE.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD = '8') THEN 1
                          WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN('CABG') AND (DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN('07','20','41')
                            OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365 OR DE.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD = '8') THEN 1
                          WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END NOT_INDEX_FLG,
                      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DP.MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR,F.FACILITY_CD ORDER BY F.DISCHARGE_DT ASC) AS RANK1
                    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_encounter F
                    INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_encounter_type DE
                        ON F.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK = DE.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK
                    INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_patient DP
                        ON F.DIM_PATIENT_SK = DP.DIM_PATIENT_SK AND F.FACILITY_CD = DP.FACILITY_CD
                    INNER JOIN base_encounter XXX
                        ON F.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = XXX.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER
                        AND F.FACILITY_CD = XXX.FACILITY_CD
                    LEFT JOIN encounter_icd10_inclusion  VE  -- this is cte table
                            ON F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = VE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
                            AND F.FACILITY_CD = VE.FACILITY_CD
                    WHERE F.DISCHARGE_DT >= PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d','20151001' )
                            AND DE.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I'
                            AND DP.LAST_NM NOT LIKE 'ZZTEST%'
                            AND DP.LAST_NM NOT LIKE 'ZZZTEST%'
                            AND F.TOTAL_CHARGES > 0
                            AND F.ACUTE_FLG = 1
                            AND DATE_DIFF(F.ADMISSION_DT,DP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,MONTH)/12 >=18
                            AND  F.FACILITY_CD||F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR   NOT IN
                          (SELECT FC_PAN
                                FROM with_covid)
                    ORDER BY RANK1;

-- =================================================================================================
-- 3. Create the Optimized Temporary Table (V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT)
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS
WITH
  -- Optimization: Pre-filter large fact tables once based on the facility code.
  Diagnosis_base AS (
    SELECT DIM_DIAG_SK, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FACILITY_CD, DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR, PRESENT_ON_ADMIT
    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_diagnosis
    WHERE facility_cd = V_FACILITY_CD
  ),
  Procedures_base AS (
    SELECT DIM_PROCEDURE_SK, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FACILITY_CD, PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR
    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_procedures
    WHERE FACILITY_CD = V_FACILITY_CD
  ),
  Encounter_base AS (
    SELECT PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FACILITY_CD, DIM_PRIMARY_ICD10_DIAG_SK, MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER, DIM_ADMITTING_PHYSICIAN_SK, DIM_ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_SK, ADMISSION_DT, DISCHARGE_DT, SOURCE_SYSTEM, DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD, ADMIT_SOURCE_CD, DIM_PATIENT_SK, DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK, LENGTH_OF_STAY, TOTAL_CHARGES, ACUTE_FLG, DIM_HOSP_SERVICE_SK, DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK
    FROM thcdnaproddata.idm.fact_encounter
    WHERE Facility_CD = V_FACILITY_CD
  ),
  ami_and_stroke_data AS (
    SELECT fe.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, fe.FACILITY_CD, re.DIAG_CONDITION AS DP_TYPE
    FROM Encounter_base fe
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D1 ON fe.DIM_PRIMARY_ICD10_DIAG_SK = D1.DIM_DIAG_SK
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re ON D1.DIAG_CD = re.DIAG_PROC_CD
      AND re.DIAG_CONDITION IN ('STROKE', 'AMI')
      AND re.SEQUENCE_NBR = 1
      AND re.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL'
  ),
  cabg_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT FP.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FP.FACILITY_CD, 'CABG' AS DP_TYPE
    FROM Procedures_base FP
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_procedure DP ON FP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK = DP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK
    INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re ON re.DIAG_CONDITION = 'CABG'
      AND DP.PROCEDURE_CD = re.DIAG_PROC_CD
      AND re.INCL_EXCL IS NOT NULL
    WHERE DP.PROCEDURE_TYPE_CD = 'ICD10'
    QUALIFY SUM(CASE WHEN re.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL' THEN 1 WHEN re.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY FP.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FP.FACILITY_CD) = 0
  ),
  excluded_hf AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT FP.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FP.FACILITY_CD, INCL_EXCL
    FROM Procedures_base FP
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_procedure DP ON FP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK = DP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK
    INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re ON re.DIAG_CONDITION = 'HF'
      AND re.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'PROC_CD'
      AND DP.PROCEDURE_CD = re.DIAG_PROC_CD
      AND re.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL'
    WHERE DP.PROCEDURE_TYPE_CD = 'ICD10'
  ),
  all_hf AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT fe.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, fe.FACILITY_CD, re.DIAG_CONDITION
    FROM Encounter_base fe
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D1 ON fe.DIM_PRIMARY_ICD10_DIAG_SK = D1.DIM_DIAG_SK
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re ON D1.DIAG_CD = re.DIAG_PROC_CD
      AND re.DIAG_CONDITION = 'HF'
      AND re.SEQUENCE_NBR = 1
      AND re.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'DIAG_CD'
  ),
  hf_data AS (
    SELECT ah.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, ah.FACILITY_CD, ah.DIAG_CONDITION AS DP_TYPE
    FROM all_hf ah
    LEFT JOIN excluded_hf eh ON ah.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = eh.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND ah.FACILITY_CD = eh.FACILITY_CD
    WHERE eh.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR IS NULL
  ),
  all_diag AS (
    SELECT
      F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD,
      MAX(CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 THEN D.DIAG_CD END) AS DIAG_CD1,
      ARRAY_AGG(CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR NOT IN (0, 1) AND F.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT = 'Y' THEN D.DIAG_CD END IGNORE NULLS) AS DIAG_CD2_ARRAY
    FROM Diagnosis_base F
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D ON F.DIM_DIAG_SK = D.DIM_DIAG_SK
    WHERE D.DIAG_CD IS NOT NULL AND (F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 OR F.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT = 'Y')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ),
  all_diag_and_pn_readmit_grouped AS (
    SELECT
      fd.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, fd.FACILITY_CD,
      MAX(CASE WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' AND (SUBSTRING(fd.DIAG_CD1, 1, 1) = 'J' OR fd.DIAG_CD1 = 'A481') THEN 2 WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' AND SUBSTRING(fd.DIAG_CD1, 1, 1) <> 'J' THEN 1 END) AS CASE1_SUM,
      MAX(CASE WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' THEN 1 WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL' THEN 4 END) AS CASE2_SUM
    FROM all_diag fd, UNNEST(fd.DIAG_CD2_ARRAY) as DIAG_CD2
    LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re1 ON re1.DIAG_CONDITION = 'PN' AND re1.SEQUENCE_NBR = 1 AND fd.DIAG_CD1 = re1.DIAG_PROC_CD
    LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re2 ON re2.DIAG_CONDITION = 'PN' AND re2.SEQUENCE_NBR = 2 AND DIAG_CD2 = re2.DIAG_PROC_CD
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ),
  pn_data AS (
    SELECT Z.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, Z.FACILITY_CD, 'PN' AS DP_TYPE
    FROM all_diag_and_pn_readmit_grouped Z
    WHERE CASE WHEN COALESCE(Z.CASE1_SUM, 0) = 2 THEN 2 ELSE COALESCE(Z.CASE1_SUM, 0) + COALESCE(Z.CASE2_SUM, 0) END = 2
  ),
  all_thk_procs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT FP.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, FP.FACILITY_CD, FP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK, CASE WHEN FP.PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR, DP.PROCEDURE_CD
    FROM Procedures_base FP
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_procedure DP ON FP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK = DP.DIM_PROCEDURE_SK
    WHERE DP.PROCEDURE_TYPE_CD = 'ICD10'
  ),
  grouped_thks_proc AS (
    SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
    FROM (
        SELECT ath.FACILITY_CD, ath.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, CASE WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL = 'INCL' THEN 0 WHEN re1.INCL_EXCL <> 'INCL' THEN 1 WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL' THEN 1 WHEN re2.INCL_EXCL <> 'EXCL' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS CRITERIA
        FROM all_thk_procs ath
        LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re1 ON ath.PROCEDURE_CD = re1.DIAG_PROC_CD AND ath.PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR = re1.SEQUENCE_NBR AND re1.DIAG_CONDITION = 'THK/TKA' AND re1.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'PROC_CD' AND re1.SEQUENCE_NBR = 1
        LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re2 ON ath.PROCEDURE_CD = re2.DIAG_PROC_CD AND ath.PROCEDURE_SEQ_NBR = re2.SEQUENCE_NBR AND re2.DIAG_CONDITION = 'THK/TKA' AND re2.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'PROC_CD' AND re2.SEQUENCE_NBR <> 1
    )
    WHERE CRITERIA IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
    HAVING SUM(CRITERIA) = 0
  ),
  grouped_thks_diag AS (
    SELECT FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, SUM(CRITERIA) AS crit
    FROM (
        SELECT rtd1.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, rtd1.FACILITY_CD, CASE WHEN rtd1.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL' OR re2.INCL_EXCL = 'EXCL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CRITERIA
        FROM (
            SELECT atd.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, atd.FACILITY_CD, atd.DIAG_SEQ_NBR, atd.DIAG_CD, re1.INCL_EXCL
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD, CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 THEN 1 WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR NOT IN (0, 1) THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS DIAG_SEQ_NBR, D.DIAG_CD
                FROM Diagnosis_base F
                JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D ON F.DIM_DIAG_SK = D.DIM_DIAG_SK
                WHERE D.DIAG_CD IS NOT NULL AND D.DIAG_TYP_CD = 'ICD10'
            ) atd
            LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re1 ON atd.DIAG_CD = re1.DIAG_PROC_CD AND atd.DIAG_SEQ_NBR = re1.SEQUENCE_NBR AND re1.DIAG_CONDITION = 'THK/TKA' AND re1.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'DIAG_CD' AND re1.SEQUENCE_NBR = 1
        ) rtd1
        LEFT JOIN thcdnaproddata.staging.readmit_incl_excl_codes re2 ON rtd1.DIAG_CD = re2.DIAG_PROC_CD AND rtd1.DIAG_SEQ_NBR = re2.SEQUENCE_NBR AND re2.DIAG_CONDITION = 'THK/TKA' AND re2.DIAG_PROC_TYPE = 'DIAG_CD' AND re2.SEQUENCE_NBR = 2
    )
    WHERE CRITERIA IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY FACILITY_CD, PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
    HAVING SUM(CRITERIA) > 0
  ),
  thk_data AS (
    SELECT tfp.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, tfp.FACILITY_CD, 'THK/TKA' AS DP_TYPE
    FROM grouped_thks_proc tfp
    LEFT JOIN grouped_thks_diag gd ON tfp.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = gd.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND tfp.FACILITY_CD = gd.FACILITY_CD
    WHERE gd.crit IS NULL
  ),
  copd_data AS (
    SELECT ic.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, ic.FACILITY_CD, 'COPD' AS DP_TYPE
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD, CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 AND D.DIAG_CD IN ('J418', 'J42', 'J410', 'J411', 'J430', 'J431', 'J432', 'J438', 'J439', 'J440', 'J441', 'J449') THEN 2 WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 AND D.DIAG_CD IN ('J9600', 'J9601', 'R0603', 'J9602', 'J9620', 'J9621', 'J9622', 'J9690', 'J9691', 'J9692', 'R092') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DIAG_CD1, CASE WHEN F.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR NOT IN (0, 1) AND D.DIAG_CD IN ('J440', 'J441') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DIAG_CD2
        FROM Diagnosis_base F
        JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D ON F.DIM_DIAG_SK = D.DIM_DIAG_SK
    ) ic
    GROUP BY ic.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, ic.FACILITY_CD
    HAVING (CASE WHEN MAX(ic.DIAG_CD1) = 2 THEN 2 ELSE MAX(ic.DIAG_CD1) + MAX(ic.DIAG_CD2) END = 2)
  ),
  all_data_combined AS (
    SELECT * FROM ami_and_stroke_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM cabg_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM hf_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM pn_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM thk_data UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM copd_data
  ),
  -- Optimization: Identify COVID encounters in a single scan.
  covid_encounters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT FD.FACILITY_CD, FD.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
    FROM Diagnosis_base FD
    JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_diag D2 ON FD.DIM_DIAG_SK = D2.DIM_DIAG_SK
    WHERE D2.DIAG_CD = 'U071' AND (FD.DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NBR = 1 OR FD.PRESENT_ON_ADMIT = 'Y')
  ),
  base_encounter_keys AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT F.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER, F.FACILITY_CD
    FROM Encounter_base F
    INNER JOIN all_data_combined V ON F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = V.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND F.FACILITY_CD = V.FACILITY_CD
  )
SELECT
  F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD, F.DIM_ADMITTING_PHYSICIAN_SK, F.DIM_ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_SK, F.ADMISSION_DT, F.DISCHARGE_DT, F.SOURCE_SYSTEM, F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD, F.ADMIT_SOURCE_CD, COALESCE(VE.DP_TYPE, 'XXX') AS DP_TYPE, DP.MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR, F.DIM_HOSP_SERVICE_SK, F.DIM_STD_REV_GRP_SK, DP.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
  CASE
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN ('THK/TKA') AND (F.ADMIT_SOURCE_CD IN ('E', 'Z', '4') OR F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN ('02','05','07','43','63','65','66','82','85','88','91','93','94','20','41') OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365) THEN 1
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN ('AMI','HF','PN','COPD','STROKE') AND (F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN ('02','05','07','43','63','65','66','82','85','88','91','93','94','20','41') OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365 OR DE.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD = '8') THEN 1
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IN ('CABG') AND (F.DISCHARGE_STATUS_CD IN ('07','20','41') OR F.LENGTH_OF_STAY > 365 OR DE.ENCOUNTER_TYPE_CD = '8') THEN 1
    WHEN VE.DP_TYPE IS NULL THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS NOT_INDEX_FLG,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DP.MEDICAL_RECORD_NBR, F.FACILITY_CD ORDER BY F.DISCHARGE_DT ASC) AS RANK1
FROM Encounter_base F
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_encounter_type DE ON F.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK = DE.DIM_ENCOUNTER_TYPE_SK
INNER JOIN thcdnaproddata.idm.dim_patient DP ON F.DIM_PATIENT_SK = DP.DIM_PATIENT_SK AND F.FACILITY_CD = DP.FACILITY_CD
INNER JOIN base_encounter_keys XXX ON F.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER = XXX.MEDICAL_RECORD_NUMBER AND F.FACILITY_CD = XXX.FACILITY_CD
LEFT JOIN all_data_combined VE ON F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = VE.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR AND F.FACILITY_CD = VE.FACILITY_CD
-- Optimization: Replaced NOT IN with a safer and more performant LEFT JOIN/IS NULL pattern.
LEFT JOIN covid_encounters ce ON F.FACILITY_CD = ce.FACILITY_CD AND F.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR = ce.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR
WHERE
  F.DISCHARGE_DT >= PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', '20151001')
  AND DE.PATIENT_CLASS_CD = 'I'
  AND DP.LAST_NM NOT LIKE 'ZZTEST%'
  AND DP.LAST_NM NOT LIKE 'ZZZTEST%'
  AND F.TOTAL_CHARGES > 0
  AND F.ACUTE_FLG = 1
  AND DATE_DIFF(F.ADMISSION_DT, DP.DATE_OF_BIRTH, MONTH) / 12 >= 18
  AND ce.PATIENT_ACCOUNT_NBR IS NULL
ORDER BY RANK1;

-- =================================================================================================
-- 4. Validation Step: Compare the two tables and check optimized duplicates.
-- DISCREPANCY counts distinct rows that appear in one table but not the other.
-- DUPLICATE ROWS counts extra copies of duplicate rows in V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT.
-- The first two SELECT statements show the actual rows when discrepancies or duplicates exist.
-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL
(SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN OPTIMIZED' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View discrepancy rows.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES;

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- The final SELECT statement shows only the summary counts.
-- =================================================================================================
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES AS
(SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
 EXCEPT DISTINCT
 SELECT 'ONLY IN ORIGINAL' AS validation_diff_type, *
 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
)
UNION ALL

 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT
 EXCEPT DISTINCT

 FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_ORIG
);

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP TABLE V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES AS
SELECT duplicate_row.*
FROM (
  SELECT ANY_VALUE(opt) AS duplicate_row
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

-- View duplicate rows from the optimized query.
SELECT *
FROM V_VALIDATION_OPT_DUPLICATES;

-- View summary counts.
SELECT 'DISCREPANCY' AS validation_check, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM V_VALIDATION_DISCREPANCIES
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DUPLICATE ROWS' AS validation_check, COALESCE(SUM(row_count - 1), 0) AS row_count
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count
  FROM V_TEMP_TABLE_OPT AS opt
  GROUP BY TO_JSON_STRING(opt)
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
);

        , encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
, encounter.REASON_FOR_VISIT AS REASON_FOR_VISIT
        , person.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED as patient_name
        , person.BIRTH_DT_TM as patient_dob
FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encounter_hist encounter
left outer JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_alias_hist encntr_alias 
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_alias.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_alias.ENCNTR_ID
and encounter.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
and encntr_alias.ENCNTR_ALIAS_TYPE_CD = 1079
and encntr_alias.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
left outer JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_alias_hist encntr_alias2 
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_alias2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_alias2.ENCNTR_ID
and encntr_alias2.ENCNTR_ALIAS_TYPE_CD = 1077 
and encntr_alias2.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
inner JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist encntr_loc_hist  
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_loc_hist.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_loc_hist.ENCNTR_ID
and  encntr_loc_hist.encntr_type_cd = 309310
inner JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist code_value 
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = code_value.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.LOC_FACILITY_CD = code_value.CODE_VALUE

and substr(code_value.display,1,3) in ('BMC','HNM','VBA','VBC','MOD','DES','IND','CYF','HHH','NFR','PMC','SRE','SYL','SRM','NMC','NM1','DHF',
'AHH','PVA','AHD','MHH','WVH','PBA','SFH','BAR','SCH','FRM','HAH','LOM','PLA','LAK','FVR','MAN','SVM','TWI','ECH','CCD','SIE','PRV','NBH',
'NCA','SLH','MTB','BMA','DHW','SPW','SES','NOS','SMH','CGH','DEL','WBO','PBG','FLO','HIA','GSM','PGH','HMD','EMC','FMM', 'RHB','SVH','FUH','WHF','TES')
inner JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_person_hist person
        on encounter.health_system_source_id = person.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
        and encounter.person_id = person.PERSON_ID
        and person.ACTIVE_IND = 1
where encounter.ACTIVE_IND = 1 

) ENC 
left JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist encntr_loc_hist  
on ENC.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_loc_hist.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and ENC.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_loc_hist.ENCNTR_ID

and encntr_loc_hist.encntr_type_cd <> 309310

       on  loc_nurse_unit_cd.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_loc_hist.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID and
              loc_nurse_unit_cd.CODE_VALUE = encntr_loc_hist.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD and

create temp table all_hs_fn_temp1 CLUSTER BY HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,encntr_id as
SELECT * FROM (
select ENC.*
,trim(substr(loc_nurse_unit_cd.DISPLAY, instr(loc_nurse_unit_cd.DISPLAY,'-')+1)) AS ADMIT_NURSING_STN
, row_number() over (partition by ENC.encntr_id,ENC.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID,ENC.fac_cd  order by ENCNTR_LOC_HIST_ID asc, BEG_EFFECTIVE_DT_TM asc nulls last) enc_loc_hist_wagg
FROM
(select  distinct encntr_alias.alias mrn 
        , encntr_alias2.alias pan
        , encounter.encntr_id
        , encounter.updt_dt_tm encounter_updt_dt_tm
        , substr(code_value.display, 1, 3) fac_cd
        , encounter.person_id
        , encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
, encounter.REASON_FOR_VISIT AS REASON_FOR_VISIT
        , person.NAME_FULL_FORMATTED as patient_name
        , person.BIRTH_DT_TM as patient_dob
FROM thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encounter_hist encounter
left outer JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_alias_hist encntr_alias 
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_alias.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_alias.ENCNTR_ID
and encounter.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
and encntr_alias.ENCNTR_ALIAS_TYPE_CD = 1079
and encntr_alias.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
left outer JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_alias_hist encntr_alias2 
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_alias2.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_alias2.ENCNTR_ID
and encntr_alias2.ENCNTR_ALIAS_TYPE_CD = 1077 
and encntr_alias2.ACTIVE_IND = 1 
inner JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist encntr_loc_hist  
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_loc_hist.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_loc_hist.ENCNTR_ID
and  encntr_loc_hist.encntr_type_cd = 309310
inner JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist code_value 
on encounter.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = code_value.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and encounter.LOC_FACILITY_CD = code_value.CODE_VALUE

and substr(code_value.display,1,3) in ('BMC','HNM','VBA','VBC','MOD','DES','IND','CYF','HHH','NFR','PMC','SRE','SYL','SRM','NMC','NM1','DHF',
'AHH','PVA','AHD','MHH','WVH','PBA','SFH','BAR','SCH','FRM','HAH','LOM','PLA','LAK','FVR','MAN','SVM','TWI','ECH','CCD','SIE','PRV','NBH',
'NCA','SLH','MTB','BMA','DHW','SPW','SES','NOS','SMH','CGH','DEL','WBO','PBG','FLO','HIA','GSM','PGH','HMD','EMC','FMM', 'RHB','SVH','FUH','WHF','TES')
inner JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_person_hist person
        on encounter.health_system_source_id = person.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID
        and encounter.person_id = person.PERSON_ID
        and person.ACTIVE_IND = 1
where encounter.ACTIVE_IND = 1 

) ENC 
left JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_encntr_loc_hist_hist encntr_loc_hist  
on ENC.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_loc_hist.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID 
and ENC.ENCNTR_ID = encntr_loc_hist.ENCNTR_ID

and encntr_loc_hist.encntr_type_cd <> 309310  
left JOIN thcdnaproddata.cerner_ods.cerner_code_value_hist loc_nurse_unit_cd
       on  loc_nurse_unit_cd.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID = encntr_loc_hist.HEALTH_SYSTEM_SOURCE_ID and
              loc_nurse_unit_cd.CODE_VALUE = encntr_loc_hist.LOC_NURSE_UNIT_CD and     
              loc_nurse_unit_cd.CODE_SET = 220 
   
) ENC_LOC where ENC_LOC.enc_loc_hist_wagg = 1
;

SELECT 'TEMP1 - ENCOUNTERS:%', @@row_count;

FROM (select *,--ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS ROWID,
 case prov_type

when 'Dentist' then 'DMS'
when 'Audiologist' then 'AUD'
when 'Licensed Physical Therapy Assistant' then 'LPTA'
when 'Licensed Nurse' then 'LPN'
when 'Social Worker' then 'LSW'
when 'Physician' then 'MD'
when 'Medical Assistant' then 'MA'
when 'Nurse Practitioner' then 'NP'
when 'Occupational Therapist' then 'OT'
when 'Optometrist' then 'OD'
when 'Pharmacist' then 'PHARMD'
when 'Physical Therapist' then 'PT'
when 'Physician Assistant' then 'PA'
when 'Registered Dietitian' then 'RD'
when 'Registered Nurse' then 'RN'
when 'Resident' then 'RES'
when 'Speech and Language Pathologist' then 'SLP'
 end  PROVIDER_TYPE_CODE,
 case prov_type
when 'Midwife' then 'Certified Nurse Midwife (CNM)'
when 'Nurse Anesthetist' then 'CERTIFIED REGISTERED NURSE ANESTHESIOLOGIST'
when 'Psychologist' then 'CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST'
when 'Dentist' then 'DENTIST'
when 'Audiologist' then 'DOCTOR OF AUDIOLOGY'
when 'Licensed Physical Therapy Assistant' then 'LICENSED PHYSICAL THERAPY ASSISTANT'
when 'Licensed Nurse' then 'LICENSED PRACTICAL NURSE'
when 'Social Worker' then 'LICENSED SOCIAL WORKER'
when 'Physician' then 'MD'
when 'Medical Assistant' then 'Medical Assistant (MA)'
when 'Nurse Practitioner' then 'Nurse Practitioner (NP)'
when 'Occupational Therapist' then 'OCCUPATIONAL THERAPIST'
when 'Optometrist' then 'OPTOMETRIST (OD)'
when 'Pharmacist' then 'PHARMACIST'
when 'Physical Therapist' then 'PHYSICAL THERAPIST (PT)'
when 'Physician Assistant' then 'Physician\'s Assistant (PA)'
when 'Registered Dietitian' then 'REGISTERED DIETITIAN'
when 'Registered Nurse' then 'Registered Nurse (RN)'
when 'Resident' then 'RESIDENT'
when 'Speech and Language Pathologist' then 'SPEECH AND LANGUAGE PATHOLOGIST'
 end  PROVIDER_TYPE_NAME
from epic_ods.bap_clarity_ser) A
left join (SELECT PROV_ID as prov_id1, REGEXP_REPLACE(BEFORE_COMMA,'[ ]{2,}',' ') AS LASTNM,
CASE 
/* If multiple words found, if length of first word is > 1 char, then put the first word as FIRSTNM */
WHEN INSTR(AFTER_COMMA, ' ',1,1) > 0 AND LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(AFTER_COMMA, '[^\\s]+',1,1)) > 1
THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(AFTER_COMMA, '[^\\s]+',1,1))
/* If multiple words found, if length of first word = 1 char, then put rest of the text after first word as FIRSTNM */
WHEN INSTR(AFTER_COMMA, ' ',1,1) > 0 AND LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(AFTER_COMMA, '[^\\s]+',1,1)) = 1
THEN TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(AFTER_COMMA, '[^ ] (.*)',1,1))
/* If only one word, then put the whole text into FIRSTNM */
WHEN INSTR(AFTER_COMMA, ' ',1,1) = 0 
THEN TRIM(AFTER_COMMA)
ELSE NULL
END AS FIRSTNM,  
CASE 
/* If multiple words found, if length of first word is > 1 char or if length of both first word and second word = 1 character, then put the rest of the text after first word as MIDNM */
WHEN INSTR(AFTER_COMMA, ' ',1,1) > 0 AND LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT(AFTER_COMMA, '[^\\s]+',1,1)) > 1
THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(AFTER_COMMA, INSTR(AFTER_COMMA, ' ',1,1)+1))

drop table if exists athena_ods.athena_provider_TEMP;
CREATE OR REPLACE table athena_ods.athena_provider_TEMP as
SELECT DISTINCT
PID_ROLLUP PID
 , CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC as INT64) END NPI
 , PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME FIRST_NAME
 , PROVIDER_LAST_NAME LAST_NAME
 , DELETED_dATETIME
 , DIM_REGION_MARKET_SK
 , IFNULL(PID_LIST_RENDERING_PROVIDER,'')||case when PID_LIST_REFERRING_PROVIDER is not null and PID_LIST_RENDERING_PROVIDER is not null then ',' else '' end ||IFNULL(PID_LIST_REFERRING_PROVIDER,'') PID_LIST
 , SCHEDULING_NAME
 , provider_type_name_corrected PROVIDER_TYPE_NAME
 , provider_user_name
 , provider_type_code

FROM
(
SELECT 
*
, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
  ORDER BY case when referring_provider_ind = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) RNK1
, FIRST_VALUE (REFERRING_PROVIDER_IND) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
  ORDER BY case when REFERRING_PROVIDER_IND = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) REFERRING_PROVIDER_IND_ROLUP
, FIRST_VALUE (PID) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
  ORDER BY case when REFERRING_PROVIDER_IND = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) PID_ROLLUP
, FIRST_VALUE (RENDERING_PID_LIST) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
  ORDER BY case when IFNULL(REFERRING_PROVIDER_IND,'') = 'Y' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) PID_LIST_RENDERING_PROVIDER
, FIRST_VALUE (REFERRING_PID_LIST) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
  ORDER BY case when IFNULL(REFERRING_PROVIDER_IND,'') = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) PID_LIST_REFERRING_PROVIDER
FROM  
( 
select * from 
(
 SELECT A.PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC
, PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME
, PROVIDER_LAST_NAME
, PROVIDER_USER_NAME
, PROVIDER_MIDDLE_INITIAL
, SCHEDULING_NAME 
, a.provider_id||'~'||a.context_id pid
, A.PROVIDER_TYPE_NAME
, DIM_REGION_MARKET_SK
, A.DELETED_dATETIME
, first_value(provider_type) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
              ORDER BY case when a.deleted_Datetime is null and provider_type is not null then 1 
  else 2 end asc, a.nz_create_ts desc) provider_type_CODE
, first_value(provider_type_name) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
              ORDER BY case when a.deleted_Datetime is null and provider_type is not null then 1 
  else 2 end asc, a.nz_create_ts desc) provider_type_name_corrected
, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))
              ORDER BY A.PROVIDER_USER_NAME DESC,
          A.FILE_TIMEKEY DESC,
          A.nz_create_ts DESC, -- updated created_datetime to nz_create_ts (vidhya)
          RM.MARKET_NM,
          provider_id desc) RNK
, String_Agg('ATHENA@'||A.PROVIDER_ID||'~'||A.CONTEXT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC END,IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME),'X')||'~'||IFNULL(UPPER(PROVIDER_LAST_NAME),'Y'))) RENDERING_PID_LIST
, cast(null as string) referring_PID_LIST
, cast(null as string) referring_provider_ind

LEFT JOIN tpr.dim_region_market RM 
ON UPPER(X.MARKET)=UPPER(RM.MARKET_NM) AND UPPER(X.REGION)=UPPER(RM.REGION_NM) AND DELETE_FLAG IS NULL 
)x
  where rnk = 1
UNION DISTINCT
   select * from 
(SELECT NPI_NUMBER PROVIDER_NPI_NUMERIC
, PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_3 PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME
, PROVIDER_LAST_NAME
, CAST(NULL AS STRING)  PROVIDER_USER_NAME
, PROVIDER_MIDDLE_INITIAL
, CAST(NULL AS STRING)  SCHEDULING_NAME 
, 'REF'||referring_provider_id||'~'||context_id  pid
,  provider_type_name 
, -99
, DELETED_dATETIME
, provider_type
, provider_type_name
, dense_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CAST(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(NPI_NUMBER,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(NPI_NUMBER as INT64) END as STRING),IFNULL(UPPER(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME),'X'))
              ORDER BY file_timekey desc, referring_provider_id desc, context_id desc) RNK
, cast(null as string) rendering_PID_LIST
, STRING_AGG('ATHENA@REF'||B.REFERRING_PROVIDER_ID||'~'||B.CONTEXT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN IFNULL(LENGTH(translate(NPI_NUMBER,CAST(1234567890 as STRING),'')),0)<>0 THEN NULL ELSE NPI_NUMBER END,IFNULL(UPPER(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME),'X'))) referring_PID_LIST
, 'Y' referring_provider_ind
FROM
(SELECT A.*, PROVIDER_TYPE_NAME, provider_type--, row_number() over (partition by 1 order by 1,A.context_id,A.referring_provider_id) rn 
, CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_2
, CASE WHEN LENGTH(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END, ABS(INSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END,' ',-1)+1))) = 1 
THEN trim(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END,1,ABS(INSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END,' ',-1)))) 
ELSE CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END
  END PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_3
, CASE WHEN LENGTH(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END, ABS(INSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END,' ',-1)+1))) = 1 
THEN trim(SUBSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END,ABS(INSTR(CASE WHEN PROVIDER_TYPE IS NOT NULL 
THEN trim(  translate(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, 1, ABS(INSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,',',-1)-1)) ,'.',' '))
  ELSE trim(translate(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1,'.', ' ')) 
END,' ',-1)))) 
ELSE NULL
  END PROVIDER_MIDDLE_INITIAL
FROM 
(SELECT x.*
, case when ENTITY_TYPE = 'Non-person entity' or ARRAY_LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME, r'(,)')) = 0 
   then REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME
   else trim(substr(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME,1,ABS(INSTR(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME,',',1)-1))) 
  end PROVIDER_last_name
, case when ENTITY_TYPE = 'Non-person entity' or ARRAY_LENGTH(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME, r'(,)')) = 0 
   then null
   else trim(substr(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME,ABS(INSTR(REFERRING_PROVIDER_NAME,',',1 )+1),100)) 
  end PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1
 FROM athena_ods.athena_referring_provider x
 join (select distinct context_id,claim_referring_provider_id from athena_ods.athena_claim ) y on x.context_id = y.context_id and x.referring_provider_id = y.claim_referring_provider_id
 ) A
LEFT JOIN (sELECT DISTINCT PROVIDER_TYPE, PROVIDER_TYPE_NAME FROM athena_ods.athena_provider )Y 
ON TRIM(SUBSTR(PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, ABS(INSTR( PROVIDER_FIRST_NAME_1, ',',-1)+1), 10)) = Y.PROVIDER_TYPE
)B
)x
  where rnk = 1
) P
)R 
WHERE RNK1 = 1;

  CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE staging.nextgen_PROVIDER_TEMP AS
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN P.source_system = 'NEXTGEN' THEN P.PROVIDER_ID
  ELSE
  'BIRM'||P.PROVIDER_ID
END
  PID,
  PROVIDER_TERMINATION_DT,
  CASE
    WHEN LENGTH(P.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID)=0 THEN NULL
  ELSE
  CAST(P.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID AS INT64)
END
  NPI,
  P.FIRST_NAME,
  P.LAST_NAME,
  P.MIDDLE_NAME,
  DIM_REGION_MARKET_SK,
  PID_LIST
FROM (
  SELECT
    A.*,
    PROVIDER_TERMINATION_DT,
    UPPER((CASE
          WHEN A.SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'NEXTGEN_BIRMINGHAM' THEN 'BIRMINGHAM'
          WHEN ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC IS NOT NULL
        AND LENGTH(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC)>12 THEN SUBSTR(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC,12, (LENGTH(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC) - 11))
          WHEN ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC)<=12 THEN ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC
      END
        )) MARKET_NM_NEXTGEN,
    DIM_REGION_MARKET_SK,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY IFNULL(CAST(CASE WHEN TRIM(A.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID)='' THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(A.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID) END AS STRING),UPPER(IFNULL((FIRST_NAME),'X'))||'~'||UPPER(IFNULL((LAST_NAME),'X'))||'~'||IFNULL(TRIM(A.ZIP),'00000')) ORDER BY A.MODIFY_TIMESTAMP DESC, A.CREATE_TIMESTAMP DESC,M.MARKET_NM DESC, PROVIDER_ID DESC) RNK, STRING_AGG(CASE
        WHEN A.SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'NEXTGEN' THEN 'NEXTGEN@'||A.PROVIDER_ID
      ELSE
      'NEXTGEN@BIRM'||A.PROVIDER_ID
    END
      ) OVER(PARTITION BY IFNULL(CASE WHEN A.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID='' THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(A.NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID) END ,UPPER(IFNULL(TRIM(FIRST_NAME),'X'))||'~'||UPPER(IFNULL(TRIM(LAST_NAME),'X'))||'~'||IFNULL(TRIM(A.ZIP),'00000'))) PID_LIST FROM  (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY NATIONAL_PROVIDER_ID  ORDER BY PROVIDER_ID ) RNK8 FROM staging.nextgen_provider_mstr) A LEFT JOIN (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS RNK9 FROM staging.nextgen_location_mstr) LM ON A.PRIMARY_LOC_ID = LM.LOCATION_ID AND A.SOURCE_SYSTEM = LM.SOURCE_SYSTEM LEFT JOIN (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS RNK10 FROM  staging.nextgen_mstr_lists) ML ON LM.LOCATION_SUBGROUPING1_ID = ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_ID AND LM.SOURCE_SYSTEM = ML.SOURCE_SYSTEM LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROVIDER_GUID, MAX(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d',END_DATE)) PROVIDER_TERMINATION_DT FROM staging.nextgen_ten_med3000_tracking GROUP BY PROVIDER_GUID ) TERM_DT ON A.PROVIDER_ID = TERM_DT.PROVIDER_GUID LEFT JOIN (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER() AS RNK11 FROM tpr.dim_region_market) M 
  ON M.MARKET_NM=UPPER((CASE
          WHEN A.SOURCE_SYSTEM = 'NEXTGEN_BIRMINGHAM' THEN 'BIRMINGHAM'
          WHEN ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC)>12 THEN SUBSTR(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC,12, (LENGTH(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC) - 11))
          WHEN ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC IS NOT NULL
        AND LENGTH(ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC)<=12 THEN ML.MSTR_LIST_ITEM_DESC
      END
        ))
    AND DELETE_FLAG IS NULL
    AND SOURCE_SYSTEMS LIKE '%NEXTGEN%') P
WHERE
  RNK=1;
